ot.t: God speaks and creation obeys. You were made on purpose, in His image, and He called His work very good.
ot.a: Before you scroll or rush today, pause and thank God for one thing He made, including you.
ot.p: Creator God, thank you for making me in your image and calling your work good.

ot.t: Sin begins by doubting God's word, and it breaks trust with God and with each other. Yet God comes looking for us.
ot.a: Notice one place where you are tempted to doubt what God said. Choose to trust Him there today.
ot.p: Lord, when I hide, thank you for coming to find me. Help me trust your word over my doubts.

ot.t: Even when the world grew corrupt, Noah walked with God. One faithful life matters to God.
ot.a: Walk with God in one ordinary choice today, even if no one around you does.
ot.p: Father, make me like Noah, faithful when it is not popular.

ot.t: God remembered Noah. The waters rose, but they also receded at God's word.
ot.a: If you feel stuck in a flood, remind yourself out loud: God has not forgotten me.
ot.p: God who remembers, thank you that the waters in my life rise and fall at your command.

ot.t: God makes covenants and keeps them. The rainbow is His promise that mercy has the final word.
ot.a: Write down one promise of God and put it where you will see it today.
ot.p: Faithful God, thank you that your promises are as sure as the rainbow.

ot.t: Babel tried to make a name for itself; God called Abram to trust Him and promised to make his name great.
ot.a: Ask yourself whose name you are building today, yours or God's. Choose one act that honors Him.
ot.p: Lord, like Abram, I will go where you lead, even when I cannot see the whole map.

ot.t: Abram let Lot choose first and trusted God to provide. He believed God, and it was counted as righteousness.
ot.a: Give someone else the first choice today, and trust God with the outcome.
ot.p: Father, I believe you. Count my trust as righteousness, as you did for Abram.

ot.t: When we try to force God's promise our own way, it hurts people. Yet God sees Hagar, and He renews His covenant with Abraham.
ot.a: Is there an area where you are running ahead of God? Hand it back to Him today.
ot.p: El Roi, the God who sees me, thank you that no one is invisible to you.

ot.t: Abraham pleaded boldly for others, and God listened. Lot's wife looked back and lost everything.
ot.a: Pray specifically for someone who is far from God today. Do not look back at what God has called you out of.
ot.p: Lord, give me Abraham's courage to pray for others, and help me not look back.

ot.t: Even after failure, God kept His promise. Isaac was born, and Sarah laughed with joy.
ot.a: Remember one promise God has already kept in your life and thank Him for it.
ot.p: Thank you, Father, for keeping your promises even when I fail.

ot.t: Abraham trusted God with what he loved most, and God provided the lamb. He still provides.
ot.a: Name what you are holding too tightly and offer it to God in prayer.
ot.p: Jehovah Jireh, you are my provider. I lay down what I love most and trust you.

ot.t: Abraham's servant prayed for specific guidance, and God led him step by step.
ot.a: Bring one specific decision to God today and ask Him to guide you clearly.
ot.p: Lord, lead me step by step as you led Abraham's servant.

ot.t: Esau traded his birthright for one meal. What we want right now can cost us what matters most.
ot.a: Before one decision today, ask: will I be glad I chose this a year from now?
ot.p: Father, guard me from trading lasting blessings for quick comforts.

ot.t: Isaac kept digging wells and reopening blessings, while deception tore Jacob's family apart.
ot.a: Keep doing the faithful thing today, and refuse any shortcut that needs a lie.
ot.p: God of Isaac, help me persevere and keep my words honest.

ot.t: Running from his mess, Jacob met God at Bethel. God promised, "I am with you and will watch over you."
ot.a: Wherever you are today, say: "Surely the Lord is in this place."
ot.p: Lord, you are with me even here. Thank you for meeting me in my wilderness.

ot.t: Leah longed to be loved by Jacob, and finally said, "This time I will praise the Lord."
ot.a: Shift your focus from what you lack to praising God for who He is.
ot.p: Father, when I feel unseen, teach me to say, "This time I will praise you."

ot.t: Laban changed Jacob's wages ten times, but God protected him and turned it for good.
ot.a: If someone is treating you unfairly, leave justice to God and keep doing what is right.
ot.p: God who protects, thank you that no one can rob what you have given me.

ot.t: Jacob wrestled with God and would not let go until he was blessed, then humbly reconciled with Esau.
ot.a: Bring your struggle honestly to God, then take one step toward peace with someone.
ot.p: Lord, I will not let go until you bless me. Make me a peacemaker.

ot.t: After pain and failure, God called Jacob back to Bethel to put away idols and worship Him.
ot.a: Remove one thing that competes with God for your attention today.
ot.p: Father, I put away my idols and return to you.

ot.t: Esau's line became great, but the promise ran through Jacob. God works His plan across generations.
ot.a: Pray for the generation after you, that they will know God.
ot.p: Lord of generations, let my faith be passed on to those after me.

ot.t: Joseph was betrayed and sold, yet God was writing a bigger story through his pain.
ot.a: If you are in a pit right now, trust that God is still writing your story.
ot.p: Father, when I am in the pit, remind me that you are not finished.

ot.t: Joseph stayed faithful in slavery and in prison. The Lord was with him, even when no one remembered him.
ot.a: Do your work today with excellence, even if no one notices.
ot.p: Lord, be with me as you were with Joseph, faithful in the hidden places.

ot.t: In one day God took Joseph from prison to the palace. God's timing is perfect, and He gives wisdom.
ot.a: Wait patiently on one thing you have been praying about; God's timing is never late.
ot.p: God of perfect timing, I trust you with my waiting.

ot.t: Joseph's brothers faced their guilt, and Joseph remembered his dreams. God was moving hearts.
ot.a: Is there something you need to own? Confess it to God today.
ot.p: Father, soften my heart and bring my hidden guilt into your light.

ot.t: Judah offered himself in place of Benjamin. Changed hearts show up in sacrifice.
ot.a: Look for one chance to put someone else's need before your own.
ot.p: Lord, change my heart so I live for others as Judah did.

ot.t: "You meant it for evil, but God sent me here." Joseph forgave and saw God's hand in his pain.
ot.a: Ask God to help you release one person who hurt you.
ot.p: Father, help me forgive as Joseph did, and see your hand in my story.

ot.t: Through Joseph's wisdom, God preserved many lives in famine. God places us where we can bless others.
ot.a: Ask: who has God placed near me today that I can help?
ot.p: Lord, make me a blessing where you have planted me.

ot.t: Jacob blessed his sons and spoke of a ruler from Judah, pointing to Jesus.
ot.a: Speak a word of blessing over someone in your family today.
ot.p: Father, thank you that your promises point to Jesus, the King from Judah.

ot.t: What others meant for evil, God meant for good. Then Israel suffered in Egypt, yet God was preparing a deliverer.
ot.a: Hold on to Genesis 50:20 in a hard situation today.
ot.p: God, thank you that you turn evil for good, and you raise up deliverers in dark times.

ot.t: God met Moses at the burning bush and answered his excuses with "I will be with you."
ot.a: Bring your biggest "I can't" to God and listen for His "I will be with you."
ot.p: I AM, thank you that you are enough for every weakness I bring.

ot.t: When obedience made things harder at first, God reminded Moses, "I am the Lord, and I will bring you out."
ot.a: If doing the right thing feels costly, keep going. God's deliverance is coming.
ot.p: Lord, when obedience gets harder, remind me that you are the Lord who saves.

ot.t: The plagues showed that the Lord is greater than every false god Egypt trusted.
ot.a: Name one thing you are tempted to trust more than God, and turn back to Him.
ot.p: Lord, you alone are God. I put my trust in you, not in lesser things.

ot.t: God protected His people even as judgment fell on Egypt. Pharaoh hardened his heart again and again.
ot.a: Respond quickly when God speaks to you; do not let your heart harden.
ot.p: Father, keep my heart soft and quick to obey.

ot.t: God made a distinction between His people and Egypt. He is just, and He protects His own.
ot.a: Thank God that He knows you by name and keeps you.
ot.p: Lord, thank you for holding me safe, even when trouble is all around.

ot.t: The Passover lamb's blood protected Israel. Jesus is our Passover Lamb.
ot.a: Thank Jesus today specifically for His blood that covers you.
ot.p: Lamb of God, thank you that your blood covers me and sets me free.

ot.t: At the Red Sea, God made a way where there was no way. "The Lord will fight for you; you need only be still."
ot.a: Bring your impossible situation to God and be still before Him.
ot.p: Lord, you make a way through the sea. I will be still and trust you.

ot.t: God gave manna every morning, enough for each day. Aaron and Hur held up Moses' hands.
ot.a: Trust God for today's needs only, and hold up someone who is tired.
ot.p: Father, give me today my daily bread, and make me someone who holds up others.

ot.t: Jethro taught Moses to share the load. Then God invited Israel to be His treasured possession.
ot.a: Delegate or ask for help with one burden you are carrying alone.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that I am your treasured possession. Teach me to share the load.

ot.t: God's commands begin with grace: "I brought you out." His law shows us how to love Him and others.
ot.a: Pick one commandment and practice it intentionally today.
ot.p: Father, write your law on my heart so I love you and my neighbor well.

ot.t: God cares about justice for the poor, the foreigner and the vulnerable.
ot.a: Do one practical thing today for someone who is struggling.
ot.p: Lord of justice, give me a heart for the weak and the forgotten.

ot.t: God invited Moses up the mountain and planned a tabernacle so He could dwell among His people.
ot.a: Make room for God's presence today: set aside ten quiet minutes with Him.
ot.p: God who dwells with us, make my heart a place where you live.

ot.t: Every detail of the tabernacle mattered to God. He is holy, and He provided a way to draw near.
ot.a: Do one small task today with care, as worship to God.
ot.p: Holy God, thank you for making a way for me to come near.

ot.t: The priest carried Israel's names on his heart before God. Jesus our High Priest carries us.
ot.a: Remember that Jesus carries your name before the Father today.
ot.p: Jesus, my High Priest, thank you for carrying me on your heart.

ot.t: The priests were set apart to serve God. In Christ, we are a royal priesthood.
ot.a: Offer your work today as service to God.
ot.p: Lord, set me apart for your service in everything I do.

ot.t: God filled Bezalel with His Spirit for craftsmanship. Every skill can be used for God.
ot.a: Use one of your skills today intentionally for God's glory.
ot.p: Spirit of God, fill my work with your wisdom and skill.

ot.t: Israel made a golden calf, but Moses interceded. God's presence is what makes His people distinct.
ot.a: Ask God for His presence in your day above any other blessing.
ot.p: Lord, if your presence does not go with me, do not send me. Go with me.

ot.t: God revealed Himself as compassionate, gracious, slow to anger and abounding in love.
ot.a: Treat someone today with the patience God shows you.
ot.p: Compassionate God, thank you that you are slow to anger and rich in love.

ot.t: The people gave so willingly that Moses had to tell them to stop. Generous hearts move God's work forward.
ot.a: Give something freely today, time, money or help, with a willing heart.
ot.p: Father, give me a generous and willing heart.

ot.t: The craftsmen built everything exactly as God instructed. Faithfulness in details honors God.
ot.a: Finish one task completely and well today.
ot.p: Lord, make me faithful in the details you give me.

ot.t: The work was done as the Lord commanded, and Moses blessed the people.
ot.a: Review what God has asked of you and take the next step of obedience.
ot.p: Father, let my life be built just as you command.

ot.t: God's glory filled the tabernacle. Then He showed how sinners can come near through sacrifice.
ot.a: Approach God today with confidence because Jesus is your sacrifice.
ot.p: Glorious God, fill my life as your glory filled the tabernacle.

ot.t: The offerings show both thanksgiving to God and the need for forgiveness, even for unintentional sin.
ot.a: Ask God to show you any hidden sin, and thank Him for forgiveness.
ot.p: Lord, forgive the sins I do not even see, and receive my thanks.

ot.t: God's law requires making things right with people we have wronged, not just with Him.
ot.a: Is there someone you need to apologize to or repay? Make it right today.
ot.p: Father, give me courage to make things right with those I have wronged.

ot.t: The fellowship offering was a meal of peace with God. In Christ, we have peace with Him.
ot.a: Share a meal or a moment of peace with someone today and thank God for it.
ot.p: Thank you, Lord, that through Jesus I have peace with you.

ot.t: After the priests were consecrated, fire came from the Lord, and the people shouted for joy.
ot.a: Worship God today with real joy; He accepts what is offered in obedience.
ot.p: Lord, let your fire fall on my worship and my life.

ot.t: Nadab and Abihu treated God's holiness lightly. God calls His people to be holy as He is holy.
ot.a: Take God seriously in one area where you have grown casual.
ot.p: Holy God, teach me to honor you as holy in all I do.

ot.t: God provided ways to restore people who were unclean. He cares about healing and restoration.
ot.a: Reach out to someone who feels left out or "unclean" today.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that you restore those who feel outside and unwelcome.

ot.t: The cleansing ritual welcomed healed people back. God's goal is always restoration.
ot.a: Celebrate someone's comeback today with encouragement.
ot.p: Father, thank you that your heart is to restore and bring me home.

ot.t: God cared about every part of life, even the body. Nothing is outside His concern.
ot.a: Bring a personal, private concern to God today; He cares.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that no part of my life is too small for you.

ot.t: On the Day of Atonement, the scapegoat carried sins away. Jesus carried ours.
ot.a: Picture your sins carried away and leave them there today.
ot.p: Jesus, thank you for carrying my sins far away.

ot.t: "Love your neighbor as yourself." God's holiness touches how we treat everyone.
ot.a: Show love today to someone you would normally overlook.
ot.p: Holy God, make me holy in how I love my neighbor.

ot.t: God called Israel to be different from the nations around them because they belonged to Him.
ot.a: Choose one way today to live differently because you belong to God.
ot.p: Lord, set me apart because I belong to you.

ot.t: Priests had to approach God with reverence. God deserves our best, not our leftovers.
ot.a: Give God your first and best today, not what is left over.
ot.p: Father, I give you my best, not my leftovers.

ot.t: God built rest and celebration into the calendar. Remembering His goodness is part of worship.
ot.a: Plan a real time of rest this week and thank God for it.
ot.p: Lord of the Sabbath, teach me to rest and to celebrate your goodness.

ot.t: The Year of Jubilee showed that the land and the people belong to God, and freedom is His heart.
ot.a: Release someone from a debt or a grudge today.
ot.p: Father, everything belongs to you. Make me generous and free.

ot.t: God promised blessing for obedience and warned of consequences, but He always remembers His covenant.
ot.a: Return to God quickly in any area where you have drifted.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that even when I wander, you remember your covenant.

ot.t: Vows to God matter. He takes our promises seriously.
ot.a: Keep one promise you have made, to God or to someone else.
ot.p: Father, help me keep my word as you keep yours.

ot.t: God counted His people and arranged them around His presence. Everyone had a place.
ot.a: Thank God that you have a place in His family.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that I am counted and have a place among your people.

ot.t: The Levites belonged to God and served at His tabernacle. Every role in God's house matters.
ot.a: Serve faithfully today in whatever role you have, big or small.
ot.p: Father, I belong to you. Use me wherever you place me.

ot.t: Each Levite family had a specific job. God gives each of us a part in His work.
ot.a: Ask God what your specific part is this season.
ot.p: Lord, show me my part and help me do it well.

ot.t: The Nazirite vow showed full devotion. Then God gave the priestly blessing: "The Lord bless you and keep you."
ot.a: Pray the blessing of Numbers 6:24–26 over someone today.
ot.p: Lord, bless me and keep me; make your face shine on me.

ot.t: Each tribe brought the same offering, and God recorded every one. He sees each gift.
ot.a: Give something to God today, knowing He sees it.
ot.p: Father, thank you that you see and remember every offering.

ot.t: The Levites were cleansed and set apart. God prepares those who serve Him.
ot.a: Ask God to cleanse and prepare you for what He has for you.
ot.p: Lord, cleanse me and prepare me for your service.

ot.t: Israel moved when the cloud moved and stayed when it stayed. They followed God's timing.
ot.a: Wait for God's leading before your next big step.
ot.p: Father, I will move when you move and wait when you wait.

ot.t: Israel complained, and God provided. He also shared the Spirit with seventy elders so Moses was not alone.
ot.a: Replace one complaint today with thanksgiving.
ot.p: Lord, forgive my complaining, and thank you for the help you send.

ot.t: Miriam and Aaron opposed Moses, and ten spies saw only giants. Caleb saw God's promise.
ot.a: Look at your challenge through God's promise, not your fear.
ot.p: Father, give me Caleb's eyes to see your promise bigger than the giants.

ot.t: Israel's unbelief cost a generation, but Caleb and Joshua followed God wholeheartedly.
ot.a: Choose to follow God wholeheartedly in one area today.
ot.p: Lord, give me a different spirit, one that follows you completely.

ot.t: Korah's pride led to rebellion. God defends those He appoints.
ot.a: Check your heart for jealousy or pride and confess it.
ot.p: Father, root out pride and envy from my heart.

ot.t: Aaron's staff budded overnight. God brings life from dead things.
ot.a: Bring something that feels dead to God and ask Him for new life.
ot.p: Lord, you make dry staffs bloom. Bring life where I see none.

ot.t: Moses struck the rock in anger. Even great leaders must honor God in how they obey.
ot.a: Obey God today in a way that honors Him, not in frustration.
ot.p: Father, help me obey you with a right heart.

ot.t: Bitten Israelites looked at the bronze snake and lived. Jesus said He would be lifted up the same way.
ot.a: Look to Jesus today in your need, not to yourself.
ot.p: Jesus, lifted up for me, I look to you and live.

ot.t: Balaam could only say what God put in his mouth. No one can curse what God has blessed.
ot.a: Stand on God's blessing over you today, not others' words.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that no one can curse what you have blessed.

ot.t: Balaam saw a star rising from Jacob. Yet Israel fell into sin at Peor.
ot.a: Guard against temptation, especially right after a spiritual high.
ot.p: Father, keep me faithful after the victories, not just before them.

ot.t: A new generation was counted. God's promises continue even when one generation fails.
ot.a: Encourage someone younger in their faith today.
ot.p: Lord, raise up a new generation that follows you.

ot.t: Zelophehad's daughters asked boldly, and God granted them justice. Joshua was chosen to lead.
ot.a: Ask God boldly for what is right today.
ot.p: Father, thank you that you hear bold and humble requests.

ot.t: Offerings marked every season, and vows were to be kept. Worship shapes the whole year.
ot.a: Set a regular rhythm for worship this week.
ot.p: Lord, let my whole year be shaped by worship.

ot.t: Israel fought Midian and did not lose one soldier. God protects His people.
ot.a: Thank God for a time He protected you completely.
ot.p: Father, thank you for your protection I do not even see.

ot.t: Reuben and Gad promised to fight alongside their brothers. Unity means sharing the battle.
ot.a: Show up for someone in your church or family who needs support.
ot.p: Lord, help me stand with my brothers and sisters in their battles.

ot.t: Moses recorded every stage of the journey. Remember where God has brought you.
ot.a: Write down three places God has brought you from.
ot.p: Faithful God, thank you for every step of my journey.

ot.t: Cities of refuge protected people from vengeance. God is our refuge.
ot.a: Run to God as your refuge in whatever you are facing.
ot.p: Lord, you are my refuge. I run to you.

ot.t: God remembered the details of inheritance. Moses retold Israel's story so they would trust God.
ot.a: Retell your story of God's faithfulness to someone today.
ot.p: Father, thank you for carrying me as a father carries his child.

ot.t: God gave the nations their land too. He rules over all the earth.
ot.a: Pray for a nation other than your own today.
ot.p: Lord of all nations, your rule is over all the earth.

ot.t: God fought for Israel. Moses urged them to remember and not forget what their eyes had seen.
ot.a: Tell someone about one thing God has done for you.
ot.p: Lord, help me never forget what you have done.

ot.t: The Ten Commandments were given again. Obeying God is how we walk in life and blessing.
ot.a: Read the Ten Commandments slowly and ask God where to grow.
ot.p: Father, give me a heart that fears you and keeps your commands.

ot.t: "Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul and strength." Teach His words at home.
ot.a: Talk about God naturally with someone at home today.
ot.p: Lord, I love you with all my heart, soul and strength.

ot.t: "Man does not live on bread alone." God humbles us to teach us to depend on Him.
ot.a: When you feel full and comfortable, remember to thank God.
ot.p: Father, keep me humble and dependent on your every word.

ot.t: God watches over His land from the beginning of the year to the end. Obedience brings blessing.
ot.a: Choose blessing today by obeying God in one specific way.
ot.p: Lord, your eyes are on me from the start of the year to its end.

ot.t: God chose the place of worship and called His people to rejoice before Him.
ot.a: Make worship joyful today, sing, give thanks, celebrate.
ot.p: Father, I rejoice before you with my whole heart.

ot.t: God commanded open-handed generosity and three joyful feasts each year.
ot.a: Be generous today with an open hand, not a tight fist.
ot.p: Lord, make my hand open and my heart glad.

ot.t: God gave guidelines for kings and prophets. Leaders must stay humble and under God's word.
ot.a: Pray for your leaders at work, church and in the nation.
ot.p: Father, give our leaders humble hearts and wisdom from your Word.

ot.t: God's law protected the innocent and valued every life.
ot.a: Stand up for someone who cannot defend themselves.
ot.p: Lord, make me a defender of the innocent.

ot.t: God cared about honesty, purity and kindness, even toward animals and neighbors.
ot.a: Return something you borrowed or help a neighbor today.
ot.p: Father, let my life show your care in everyday things.

ot.t: God commanded leaving some harvest for the poor and remembering that Israel had been slaves.
ot.a: Remember where God brought you from, and share with someone in need.
ot.p: Lord, I was once in need. Make me generous like you.

ot.t: The people declared God's law on the mountains. Words of commitment matter.
ot.a: Say out loud one commitment you are making to God.
ot.p: Father, I commit myself to your ways.

ot.t: Obedience brings blessing; disobedience brings loss. God makes the stakes clear because He loves us.
ot.a: Choose obedience in one area you have been avoiding.
ot.p: Lord, I choose your blessing by choosing your ways.

ot.t: "Choose life." God's word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart.
ot.a: Make one conscious choice for life and faithfulness today.
ot.p: Father, I choose life. I choose you.

ot.t: "Be strong and courageous; the Lord goes before you." Moses' song called Israel to remember God.
ot.a: Face one fear today knowing God goes ahead of you.
ot.p: Lord, you go before me. I will not be afraid.

ot.t: "The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms." Moses finished well.
ot.a: Lean on God's everlasting arms in whatever you face today.
ot.p: Eternal God, thank you that your everlasting arms are beneath me.

ot.t: God told Joshua to be strong and courageous and to meditate on His Word. Then He opened the Jordan.
ot.a: Meditate on one verse today, morning and night.
ot.p: Lord, as you were with Moses, be with me.

ot.t: Israel set up stones of remembrance. God wants us to remember His works.
ot.a: Create a simple reminder of something God has done for you.
ot.p: Father, these are my stones of remembrance: you have been faithful.

ot.t: Jericho fell through obedience, not strength. Achan's hidden sin hurt everyone.
ot.a: Obey God's way today even if it seems strange, and bring hidden things to light.
ot.p: Lord, I will do it your way. Search me and remove what is hidden.

ot.t: After restoration, God gave victory at Ai. But Israel did not ask God about the Gibeonites.
ot.a: Ask God before you decide, especially when things look obvious.
ot.p: Father, I will ask before I act.

ot.t: God made the sun stand still. He fights for His people.
ot.a: Ask God to fight a battle you cannot win alone.
ot.p: Lord, you fight for me. Nothing is too hard for you.

ot.t: God gave victory, but there was still land to take. Keep going in what God has started.
ot.a: Take the next step in something God has started in you.
ot.p: Father, help me finish what you have begun in me.

ot.t: At 85, Caleb said, "Give me this mountain." Wholehearted faith does not retire.
ot.a: Ask God for a fresh mountain of faith, whatever your age.
ot.p: Lord, give me Caleb's heart, wholehearted to the end.

ot.t: The tribes received their inheritance, but some did not drive out their enemies fully.
ot.a: Do not settle for partial obedience. Finish what God asks.
ot.p: Father, help me take all you have given me.

ot.t: Joshua asked, "How long will you wait before you take possession?"
ot.a: Stop waiting on something God has already told you to do.
ot.p: Lord, give me courage to act on what you have said.

ot.t: God provided cities of refuge for mercy. Even in the details, His justice is merciful.
ot.a: Show mercy to someone today who needs a second chance.
ot.p: Thank you, Lord, for being my refuge and my mercy.

ot.t: "Not one of God's good promises failed; every one was fulfilled."
ot.a: Thank God for a promise He has fulfilled for you.
ot.p: Faithful God, not one of your promises has failed.

ot.t: "Choose this day whom you will serve. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."
ot.a: Decide again today: you and your household will serve the Lord.
ot.p: Lord, as for me and my house, we will serve you.

ot.t: Israel left enemies in the land, and they became snares.
ot.a: Remove one compromise before it grows.
ot.p: Father, help me deal fully with sin before it ensnares me.

ot.t: A generation arose that did not know the Lord. God raised up judges when they cried out.
ot.a: Share God's works with someone younger so they know Him.
ot.p: Lord, let the next generation know you and your works.

ot.t: Deborah led with faith, and Jael acted boldly. God uses unexpected people.
ot.a: Do not underestimate how God can use you today.
ot.p: Father, use me, ordinary as I am, for your purposes.

ot.t: God called fearful Gideon a mighty warrior and won with 300 men so Israel would not boast.
ot.a: Bring your weakness to God and let Him show His strength.
ot.p: Lord, you see me as you see Gideon. Win the battle so you get the glory.

ot.t: After victory, Gideon made an ephod that became a snare. Success can lead us astray.
ot.a: Give God the credit for your recent wins.
ot.p: Father, keep me humble after victory.

ot.t: Abimelech grabbed power and destroyed himself. Israel cried out, and God's heart was grieved for them.
ot.a: Ask whether ambition is driving you more than God is.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that your heart grieves for us when we suffer.

ot.t: Jephthah was rejected, yet God used him. His rash vow shows the danger of careless words.
ot.a: Think before you promise. Speak carefully today.
ot.p: Father, guard my mouth and make my words wise.

ot.t: Samson was set apart from birth, but he treated his calling lightly.
ot.a: Take your calling seriously; do not trade it for impulse.
ot.p: Lord, help me honor the calling you have given me.

ot.t: Samson fell through compromise, but God heard his final prayer.
ot.a: If you have fallen, cry out. God still hears.
ot.p: Father, remember me and strengthen me again.

ot.t: "Everyone did what was right in their own eyes." Without God, morality collapses.
ot.a: Ask whether you follow God's Word or your own feelings in one area.
ot.p: Lord, be my King. I do not want to do only what seems right to me.

ot.t: Israel fought its own brothers. Sin divides God's family.
ot.a: Pray for unity in your church and family.
ot.p: Father, heal the divisions among your people.

ot.t: Israel ended in confusion, but Ruth chose loyalty: "Your God will be my God."
ot.a: Show loyal love to someone who needs it.
ot.p: Lord, your people will be my people, and you are my God.

ot.t: Boaz, the redeemer, showed kindness to Ruth. God was weaving the line of David and Jesus.
ot.a: Show kindness generously today; you do not know what God is weaving.
ot.p: Jesus, my Redeemer, thank you for taking me in.

ot.t: Hannah poured out her heart to God, and He answered. She gave Samuel back to Him.
ot.a: Pour out one deep longing to God in honest prayer.
ot.p: Lord, hear the cry of my heart as you heard Hannah.

ot.t: God honors those who honor Him. Samuel listened: "Speak, Lord, your servant is listening."
ot.a: Sit quietly for five minutes today and say, "Speak, Lord."
ot.p: Speak, Lord. Your servant is listening.

ot.t: The ark was not a lucky charm. When Israel returned to God, He gave victory: "Thus far the Lord has helped us."
ot.a: Thank God that He has helped you this far.
ot.p: Ebenezer, thus far you have helped me.

ot.t: Israel asked for a king like the nations. God gave Saul, but their request rejected God as King.
ot.a: Notice where you want to be like everyone else, and choose God's way.
ot.p: Lord, you are my King. I do not need to be like everyone else.

ot.t: God changed Saul's heart, and Samuel promised to keep praying for Israel.
ot.a: Pray for someone you have been neglecting in prayer.
ot.p: Father, I will not sin against you by failing to pray for others.

ot.t: Saul grew impatient and disobeyed. Waiting on God is part of obeying God.
ot.a: Do not rush ahead of God in something you are waiting on.
ot.p: Lord, give me patience to wait on you.

ot.t: Jonathan trusted God against the odds. Saul learned that obedience is better than sacrifice.
ot.a: Choose obedience today over looking spiritual.
ot.p: Father, I will obey rather than just perform.

ot.t: God looks at the heart, not appearance. He chose young David.
ot.a: Treat someone with value today regardless of how they look or rank.
ot.p: Lord, look at my heart and make it pleasing to you.

ot.t: David faced Goliath in the name of the Lord. The battle belongs to God.
ot.a: Face your giant today in God's name, not your strength.
ot.p: Lord, the battle is yours. I come in your name.

ot.t: Saul's jealousy grew, but God protected David through Jonathan and Michal.
ot.a: Celebrate someone else's success today without envy.
ot.p: Father, free me from jealousy and thank you for friends who protect me.

ot.t: Jonathan and David's friendship was sealed before God. Covenant friendship is a gift.
ot.a: Reach out to a faithful friend and thank them.
ot.p: Thank you, Lord, for friends who love me like Jonathan loved David.

ot.t: David spared Saul's life. He refused to take revenge and waited on God.
ot.a: Refuse to get even with someone today.
ot.p: Lord, I leave vengeance to you.

ot.t: Abigail's wisdom stopped David from bloodshed. God sends people to turn us back.
ot.a: Listen to wise counsel today, even when you are upset.
ot.p: Father, thank you for the Abigails you send to stop me.

ot.t: David spared Saul again. Saul, desperate, sought a medium instead of God.
ot.a: When you feel desperate, turn to God, not to shortcuts.
ot.p: Lord, in desperation I will seek you, not other voices.

ot.t: When everything was taken, "David strengthened himself in the Lord his God."
ot.a: Strengthen yourself in God today by recalling His promises.
ot.p: Father, in loss I find my strength in you.

ot.t: David mourned Saul instead of celebrating. Grace honors even those who hurt us.
ot.a: Speak well of someone who has been unkind to you.
ot.p: Lord, give me a heart that honors others, even enemies.

ot.t: David refused to celebrate Abner's murder. He wanted justice, not revenge.
ot.a: Choose integrity even when it would be easier to look away.
ot.p: Father, keep my hands clean and my heart just.

ot.t: David danced before the Lord with all his might. Worship is wholehearted.
ot.a: Worship God freely today, without worrying what others think.
ot.p: Lord, I will celebrate before you with all my might.

ot.t: David wanted to build God a house; God promised to build David a house forever.
ot.a: Thank God for what He is building in your life.
ot.p: Who am I, Lord, that you have brought me this far?

ot.t: David showed kindness to Mephibosheth, but fell into sin with Bathsheba when he stayed home.
ot.a: Show kindness to someone who cannot repay, and guard against idleness.
ot.p: Lord, guard me in moments of comfort and make me kind.

ot.t: Nathan confronted David, and David confessed, "I have sinned." Sin brings painful consequences.
ot.a: Respond quickly to God's conviction; do not defend yourself.
ot.p: Father, I have sinned against you. Thank you for your forgiveness.

ot.t: God devises ways so that the banished are not cast out forever.
ot.a: Pray for someone who feels far from God or family.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that you make a way for the banished to come home.

ot.t: Fleeing Absalom, David trusted God even when cursed. He let God judge.
ot.a: When people speak against you, trust God to defend you.
ot.p: Father, I trust you to vindicate me.

ot.t: David grieved deeply for Absalom. A father's love does not stop even after rebellion.
ot.a: Pray for a prodigal in your life today.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that your love does not give up on prodigals.

ot.t: David returned with mercy, sparing those who had wronged him.
ot.a: Choose mercy toward someone who has failed you.
ot.p: Father, make me merciful as you are merciful.

ot.t: Rebellion continued, but wisdom from a woman of Abel saved a city.
ot.a: Speak a wise, calm word into a tense situation.
ot.p: Lord, give me wisdom that brings peace.

ot.t: "The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer." David praised God for rescue.
ot.a: Write a short thanksgiving for a rescue God has given you.
ot.p: Lord, you are my rock, my fortress and my deliverer.

ot.t: David's mighty men were loyal. David refused to offer God what cost him nothing.
ot.a: Give God something today that costs you.
ot.p: Father, I will not offer you what costs me nothing.

ot.t: Adonijah tried to grab the throne, but God's choice of Solomon stood.
ot.a: Trust God's timing instead of grabbing for position.
ot.p: Lord, I wait for your appointment, not my own ambition.

ot.t: David charged Solomon: "Be strong, walk in God's ways, and keep His commands."
ot.a: Ask God for strength to walk in His ways today.
ot.p: Father, help me walk in your ways all my days.

ot.t: Solomon asked for wisdom instead of riches, and God gave him both.
ot.a: Ask God for wisdom about one real situation today.
ot.p: Lord, give me an understanding heart to know right from wrong.

ot.t: Solomon began building God's temple with care and excellence.
ot.a: Do your work today with excellence as an offering.
ot.p: Father, let my work be a temple of praise to you.

ot.t: Solomon spent thirteen years on his palace and seven on the temple. Our priorities show.
ot.a: Look at your calendar and ask whether God gets first place.
ot.p: Lord, let my priorities honor you.

ot.t: At the temple dedication, Solomon prayed, "Even the heavens cannot contain you." God's glory filled the house.
ot.a: Pray Solomon's prayer: hear us and forgive.
ot.p: God whom the heavens cannot contain, dwell with me.

ot.t: God warned Solomon to stay faithful. The queen of Sheba praised God for Solomon's wisdom.
ot.a: Let someone see God's goodness through your wisdom today.
ot.p: Lord, let my life point others to you.

ot.t: Solomon's heart was turned away by many loves. Divided hearts lead to ruin.
ot.a: Guard your heart against anything that pulls it from God.
ot.p: Father, give me an undivided heart.

ot.t: Rehoboam rejected wise counsel, and the kingdom split. A prophet disobeyed and lost his life.
ot.a: Listen to wise, older counsel today, and obey God fully.
ot.p: Lord, help me listen to wisdom and obey you completely.

ot.t: Jeroboam's idolatry brought judgment. God sees what we set up in His place.
ot.a: Remove one idol from your heart today.
ot.p: Father, tear down every idol in my life.

ot.t: Asa's heart was fully devoted to the Lord, while other kings did evil.
ot.a: Choose wholehearted devotion today.
ot.p: Lord, make my heart fully devoted to you.

ot.t: God fed Elijah, raised a widow's son, and sent fire on Mount Carmel. "How long will you waver?"
ot.a: Stop wavering in one area and fully follow God.
ot.p: Lord, you alone are God. I will not waver.

ot.t: Exhausted, Elijah wanted to die. God gave him rest, food and a gentle whisper.
ot.a: Rest today if you are worn out, and listen for God's gentle whisper.
ot.p: Father, meet me in my exhaustion with your still, small voice.

ot.t: God gave Ahab victories, but Ahab stole Naboth's vineyard. God sees injustice.
ot.a: Do not take what is not yours, in big or small ways.
ot.p: Lord, you see every injustice. Keep me honest.

ot.t: Micaiah spoke the truth when everyone else flattered the king.
ot.a: Speak the truth in love today, even if it is unpopular.
ot.p: Father, give me courage to say what you say.

ot.t: Elijah was taken up, and Elisha asked for a double portion of his spirit.
ot.a: Ask God boldly for more of His Spirit.
ot.p: Lord, give me a double portion of your Spirit.

ot.t: God filled empty jars with oil and gave a son and life back to the Shunammite.
ot.a: Bring your "empty jars" to God and ask Him to fill them.
ot.p: Father, fill my empty places with your provision.

ot.t: Naaman was healed by humble obedience. Elisha prayed, "Open his eyes to see."
ot.a: Pray for your eyes to see God's protection around you.
ot.p: Lord, open my eyes to see that those with me are more than those against me.

ot.t: Four lepers said, "We are not doing right; this is a day of good news." Share it.
ot.a: Share good news of God with someone today.
ot.p: Father, I will not keep your good news to myself.

ot.t: Jehu carried out God's judgment on Ahab's house. God's word comes true.
ot.a: Trust that God keeps His word, even when it takes time.
ot.p: Lord, your word always comes to pass.

ot.t: Jehu was zealous but incomplete. Jehoash was protected and crowned as a child.
ot.a: Ask God to make your devotion complete, not partial.
ot.p: Father, guard what you have planted, even in small beginnings.

ot.t: Joash repaired the temple, but kings drifted when they stopped listening to God.
ot.a: Repair one neglected spiritual habit this week.
ot.p: Lord, restore what has fallen into disrepair in my walk with you.

ot.t: King after king did evil or only partly good. Partial obedience leaves high places standing.
ot.a: Identify a "high place" you have tolerated and remove it.
ot.p: Father, I do not want partial obedience. Make me wholly yours.

ot.t: Israel fell to Assyria because they rejected God's warnings again and again.
ot.a: Respond to God's warnings today while your heart is soft.
ot.p: Lord, keep me from ignoring your voice.

ot.t: Hezekiah trusted the Lord and held fast to Him. When threatened, he refused to bow.
ot.a: Hold fast to God in one area where you feel pressured.
ot.p: Lord, I trust in you like Hezekiah did.

ot.t: Hezekiah spread the threatening letter before the Lord, and God answered. He also added years to his life.
ot.a: Spread your worry out before God in prayer today, literally if needed.
ot.p: Father, I lay this before you. You alone are God.

ot.t: Manasseh led Judah into great evil, but Josiah found the Book of the Law and tore his robes.
ot.a: Read God's Word today with a humble, responsive heart.
ot.p: Lord, let your Word cut to my heart and change me.

ot.t: Josiah led a sweeping reform. No king before him turned to God with all his heart like him.
ot.a: Make one bold change in your life that honors God.
ot.p: Father, help me turn to you with all my heart, soul and strength.

ot.t: Jerusalem fell, but God kept a remnant. Chronicles begins with names, because God remembers people.
ot.a: Thank God that He knows your name in His story.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that even in ruin, you remember your people.

ot.t: Long lists of names show God's faithfulness through every family line.
ot.a: Pray for your family line, past and future.
ot.p: Father, be faithful to my family through every generation.

ot.t: David's descendants are listed. God kept His promise of a royal line leading to Jesus.
ot.a: Remember that God keeps promises over centuries.
ot.p: Lord, thank you for keeping your promise through David to Jesus.

ot.t: Jabez prayed for blessing and protection, and God granted his request.
ot.a: Pray boldly and honestly like Jabez today.
ot.p: Lord, bless me, enlarge my territory, keep your hand on me, and keep me from harm.

ot.t: The Levites ministered in song before the Lord. Worship was a calling.
ot.a: Make worship a priority in your day today.
ot.p: Father, let my life be a song before you.

ot.t: Even small tribes are recorded. No one in God's family is forgotten.
ot.a: Encourage someone who feels overlooked.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that no one is forgotten in your family.

ot.t: Benjamin's line includes Saul's family. God records the whole story, honor and failure alike.
ot.a: Bring your whole story, good and bad, to God.
ot.p: Father, thank you that my whole story is safe with you.

ot.t: Saul died because he was unfaithful and did not seek the Lord.
ot.a: Seek God first today before seeking advice anywhere else.
ot.p: Lord, I will seek you first.

ot.t: David's mighty men risked their lives for him. Loyalty and courage honor God's chosen leader.
ot.a: Show loyalty and courage for someone today.
ot.p: Father, make me loyal and brave for your kingdom.

ot.t: Many joined David with understanding of the times. But moving the ark the wrong way brought death.
ot.a: Ask God for wisdom to understand the times, and do things His way.
ot.p: Lord, give me understanding and help me honor you in how I serve.

ot.t: David asked God before each battle and moved the ark with joy and reverence.
ot.a: Ask God before you act today, even in things that seem obvious.
ot.p: Father, I will inquire of you before I move.

ot.t: "Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good." God promised David an everlasting kingdom.
ot.a: Give thanks out loud for three ways God has been good.
ot.p: Lord, you are good, and your love endures forever.

ot.t: God gave David victory wherever he went, and David ruled with justice.
ot.a: Give God credit for your victories today.
ot.p: Father, every victory is yours.

ot.t: David's pride brought judgment, but he repented and prepared for the temple.
ot.a: Turn a failure into a fresh act of obedience.
ot.p: Lord, even after I fail, let me prepare for your work.

ot.t: David organized the Levites for service. God's work is ordered and purposeful.
ot.a: Bring order to one area of your life for God.
ot.p: Father, bring order and purpose to my service.

ot.t: Musicians and gatekeepers had assigned roles. Every task in God's house matters.
ot.a: Serve gladly in a small task today.
ot.p: Lord, I will serve gladly wherever you place me.

ot.t: "Know God and serve Him with wholehearted devotion and a willing mind."
ot.a: Serve God today with a willing mind.
ot.p: Father, I will serve you with wholehearted devotion.

ot.t: David praised God as owner of everything. Solomon asked for wisdom.
ot.a: Remember that everything you have comes from God.
ot.p: Everything comes from you, Lord, and I give you only what is yours.

ot.t: Solomon built the temple for God's name, not his own.
ot.a: Do something today for God's name, not your reputation.
ot.p: Lord, let all I build be for your name.

ot.t: Glory filled the temple as they sang, "He is good; His love endures forever."
ot.a: Sing or pray "He is good; His love endures forever" today.
ot.p: Father, fill my life with your glory as I praise you.

ot.t: "If my people humble themselves and pray, I will hear and heal their land."
ot.a: Humble yourself and pray for your nation today.
ot.p: Lord, I humble myself and seek your face. Heal our land.

ot.t: The queen of Sheba praised God. Later, the kingdom split through harshness.
ot.a: Speak gently today, especially when you have authority.
ot.p: Father, give me wisdom and gentleness in leadership.

ot.t: When Rehoboam abandoned God, he lost much. Abijah won because Judah relied on the Lord.
ot.a: Rely on God openly in a challenge today.
ot.p: Lord, we rely on you. You are with us.

ot.t: Asa relied on God and won, but later relied on man. Jehoshaphat sought God.
ot.a: Ask yourself: am I relying on God or on people in this?
ot.p: Father, keep me relying on you to the end.

ot.t: Jehoshaphat allied with Ahab and nearly died. Then he appointed judges to fear God.
ot.a: Avoid alliances that pull you away from God.
ot.p: Lord, guard me from partnerships that compromise my faith.

ot.t: "We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you." God won the battle through praise.
ot.a: When you do not know what to do, fix your eyes on God and praise Him.
ot.p: Lord, I do not know what to do, but my eyes are on you.

ot.t: Joash did right while Jehoiada lived, then drifted. Faith must be personal, not borrowed.
ot.a: Make your faith your own today, not dependent on others.
ot.p: Father, let my faith stand even when others are gone.

ot.t: Uzziah was blessed as long as he sought God, then pride brought his downfall.
ot.a: Stay humble in success; keep seeking God.
ot.p: Lord, keep me humble when I am strong.

ot.t: Jotham grew mighty because he walked steadily before God. Ahaz grew worse under pressure.
ot.a: Walk steadily with God today, especially under stress.
ot.p: Father, keep me steady before you.

ot.t: Hezekiah reopened the temple and called everyone back to God with joy.
ot.a: Reopen a neglected spiritual practice today.
ot.p: Lord, open the doors of my heart again.

ot.t: "With him is the arm of flesh, but with us is the Lord our God to help us."
ot.a: Remind yourself today that God is with you, bigger than any threat.
ot.p: Lord, you are with me to help me and fight my battles.

ot.t: Manasseh humbled himself, and God restored him. No one is beyond grace. Josiah sought God young.
ot.a: Pray for someone you think is too far gone.
ot.p: Father, thank you that no one is beyond your mercy.

ot.t: Josiah kept the Passover, but Judah fell. God then moved Cyrus to let His people return.
ot.a: Trust that God can move even rulers to fulfill His promises.
ot.p: Lord, you turn the hearts of kings. I trust your plans.

ot.t: The returning exiles are listed by name. God brought His people home.
ot.a: Thank God for bringing you home to Him.
ot.p: Father, thank you for bringing me back to you.

ot.t: They rebuilt the altar first, then laid the foundation amid weeping and joy. Opposition came.
ot.a: Put worship first, and keep building despite opposition.
ot.p: Lord, I will build my life on worship, whatever the opposition.

ot.t: Encouraged by prophets, the people resumed building, and God turned the king's heart to help.
ot.a: Restart something God told you to do and let others encourage you.
ot.p: Father, give me courage to resume your work.

ot.t: Ezra devoted himself to study, obey and teach God's Word. God's hand was on him.
ot.a: Study one passage today, then obey it.
ot.p: Lord, help me study, obey and teach your Word.

ot.t: Ezra grieved over the people's sin and led them in repentance.
ot.a: Ask God to give you a heart that grieves over sin.
ot.p: Father, I confess my sin and the sins of my people.

ot.t: Nehemiah wept, prayed, then planned. Everyone built the wall near their own home.
ot.a: Pray, plan, and start the work nearest to you.
ot.p: Lord, give me success as I work for you.

ot.t: "Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome." Nehemiah also defended the poor against injustice.
ot.a: Work with one hand and hold your weapon of prayer with the other.
ot.p: Father, I will remember you, great and awesome, and fight for what is right.

ot.t: Nehemiah refused distraction: "I am doing a great work and cannot come down." The wall was finished in 52 days.
ot.a: Say no to one distraction today.
ot.p: Lord, keep me focused on the work you have given me.

ot.t: Ezra read the Law, and the people wept. "The joy of the Lord is your strength."
ot.a: Let God's Word bring you joy, not just conviction.
ot.p: Father, your joy is my strength.

ot.t: The Levites recounted God's faithfulness and confessed Israel's unfaithfulness. "You are a forgiving God."
ot.a: Recount God's faithfulness in your life in prayer.
ot.p: Lord, you are gracious and compassionate. You did not abandon us.

ot.t: The people made a binding commitment, and volunteers moved into Jerusalem.
ot.a: Make a concrete commitment to God this week.
ot.p: Father, I bind myself to follow your ways.

ot.t: The wall was dedicated with great joy that could be heard far away.
ot.a: Celebrate a completed work with thanksgiving.
ot.p: Lord, let my joy in you be heard far away.

ot.t: Nehemiah fought compromise again. Queen Vashti refused the king.
ot.a: Watch for old compromises creeping back.
ot.p: Father, keep me faithful long after the walls are built.

ot.t: Esther was placed in the palace "for such a time as this."
ot.a: Ask God why He has placed you where you are right now.
ot.p: Lord, use me for such a time as this.

ot.t: Esther risked her life, and God reversed everything. Haman fell, and the Jews were saved.
ot.a: Take one courageous step of faith today.
ot.p: Father, you reverse what seems hopeless. I trust you.

ot.t: Sorrow turned to joy at Purim. Then Job lost everything and worshiped: "Blessed be the name of the Lord."
ot.a: Worship God today regardless of your circumstances.
ot.p: The Lord gives and the Lord takes away; blessed be your name.

ot.t: Job refused to curse God. His friends sat in silence, then began to speak.
ot.a: Sit with someone who is suffering. Sometimes presence is better than words.
ot.p: Lord, help me comfort others with presence, not just answers.

ot.t: Eliphaz offered neat answers. Job longed for compassion, not lectures.
ot.a: Listen more than you speak to someone hurting.
ot.p: Father, make me a compassionate friend.

ot.t: Job was honest with God in his pain. Bildad assumed Job had sinned.
ot.a: Be honest with God about how you feel today.
ot.p: Lord, I can bring you my rawest feelings.

ot.t: Job longed for a mediator between him and God. Jesus is that mediator.
ot.a: Thank Jesus that He stands between you and God.
ot.p: Jesus, you are the mediator Job longed for.

ot.t: Zophar judged Job harshly. Job knew God's wisdom and power are over all.
ot.a: Avoid judging someone's suffering today.
ot.p: Father, all wisdom and power belong to you.

ot.t: "Though He slay me, yet will I hope in Him." Job held on.
ot.a: Choose hope in God in one discouraging situation.
ot.p: Lord, even when I do not understand, I hope in you.

ot.t: Job's friends became "miserable comforters." Job still believed his witness was in heaven.
ot.a: Speak only words that bring life to someone today.
ot.p: Father, my witness and advocate is in heaven.

ot.t: "I know that my Redeemer lives." Job's faith pierced through despair.
ot.a: Declare out loud today: "My Redeemer lives."
ot.p: I know that my Redeemer lives, and I will see you.

ot.t: Zophar said the wicked always suffer; Job saw life is more complex. God is not a formula.
ot.a: Trust God even when life does not make sense.
ot.p: Lord, you are not a formula. I trust you anyway.

ot.t: Job longed to find God and said, "He knows the way I take; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold."
ot.a: Trust that God knows the way you are taking.
ot.p: Father, refine me and bring me out as gold.

ot.t: Job saw injustice in the world. Even so, creation shows only the outer fringe of God's power.
ot.a: Look at the sky or nature today and remember how great God is.
ot.p: Lord, these are only the edges of your ways.

ot.t: Wisdom cannot be bought. "The fear of the Lord, that is wisdom."
ot.a: Ask God for wisdom instead of more information today.
ot.p: Father, teach me the fear of the Lord.

ot.t: Job remembered his days of blessing and grieved his losses.
ot.a: Thank God for past blessings, and bring your grief to Him honestly.
ot.p: Lord, you were with me in good days, and you are with me now.

ot.t: Job defended his integrity. Elihu, younger, finally spoke.
ot.a: Live with integrity even when no one is watching.
ot.p: Father, keep my heart and my eyes pure.

ot.t: God speaks in many ways, even in pain, to turn us back. God is never unjust.
ot.a: Listen for what God may be saying through a hard season.
ot.p: Lord, speak to me, even through what hurts.

ot.t: Elihu pointed to God's greatness and His care in affliction.
ot.a: Thank God that He woos you out of distress.
ot.p: Father, you are great beyond my understanding.

ot.t: God thunders in marvelous ways. Elihu urged Job to stop and consider God's wonders.
ot.a: Stop and consider one of God's wonders today.
ot.p: Lord, I stand still and consider your wonders.

ot.t: God answered Job from the whirlwind: "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?"
ot.a: Let God's greatness put your worries in perspective today.
ot.p: Lord, I put my hand over my mouth. You are God, and I am not.

ot.t: God showed His power over the mightiest creatures. Job learned humility.
ot.a: Humble yourself before God in one area of pride.
ot.p: Father, I am small, and you are mighty.

ot.t: God restored Job. Ecclesiastes asks, "What does a person gain from all their labor under the sun?"
ot.a: Ask what you are chasing, and whether it lasts.
ot.p: Lord, my ears had heard of you, but now my eyes have seen you.

ot.t: There is a time for everything. God has set eternity in our hearts. Two are better than one.
ot.a: Trust God with your timing and invest in a friendship.
ot.p: Father, you make everything beautiful in its time.

ot.t: Guard your words before God, be content, and remember that a good name is better than wealth.
ot.a: Be quick to listen and slow to speak today.
ot.p: Lord, help me be content and honor you with my words.

ot.t: God's ways are beyond our understanding. Enjoy life as His gift and work with all your might.
ot.a: Do today's work with all your might, as a gift from God.
ot.p: Father, I receive this day as your gift.

ot.t: "Remember your Creator in the days of your youth." The Song celebrates love as God's good gift.
ot.a: Remember your Creator today in a fresh way.
ot.p: Lord, I remember you. Thank you for the gift of love.

ot.t: Love is strong and worth waiting for. Do not awaken love before its time.
ot.a: Thank God for love in your life and honor it with patience.
ot.p: Father, thank you for the gift of faithful love.

ot.t: "Love is as strong as death." Isaiah calls, "Come, let us reason together; though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be white as snow."
ot.a: Bring one sin to God and receive His cleansing.
ot.p: Lord, wash me and make me white as snow.

ot.t: God will judge the nations, and pride will be humbled. "Come, let us walk in the light of the Lord."
ot.a: Choose to walk in God's light in one decision today.
ot.p: Father, I will walk in your light.

ot.t: Isaiah saw the Lord, high and lifted up, and said, "Here am I. Send me."
ot.a: Answer God's call today: "Here am I. Send me."
ot.p: Holy, holy, holy Lord. Here am I. Send me.

ot.t: "The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel."
ot.a: Remember that God is with you, Immanuel.
ot.p: Immanuel, thank you that you are God with us.

ot.t: "For to us a child is born... Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace."
ot.a: Call on Jesus by one of these names today.
ot.p: Jesus, my Wonderful Counselor and Prince of Peace.

ot.t: A Branch from Jesse will rule with righteousness. "With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation."
ot.a: Draw joy from God's salvation today.
ot.p: Lord, I will trust and not be afraid. You are my strength and song.

ot.t: God humbles proud nations. His plans stand.
ot.a: Trust that God's purposes will stand over the world's chaos.
ot.p: Father, your plans stand, and no one can stop them.

ot.t: God rules over all nations, even Egypt and Babylon. One day nations will worship Him together.
ot.a: Pray for nations in conflict today.
ot.p: Lord, rule over the nations and bring them to worship you.

ot.t: God judges self-reliance. Even the earth will answer to Him.
ot.a: Repent of trusting your own plans over God.
ot.p: Father, I trust you, not my own strength.

ot.t: God will swallow up death forever and wipe away every tear. "You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast."
ot.a: Fix your mind on God and receive His peace.
ot.p: Lord, keep me in perfect peace as I trust in you.

ot.t: God laid a precious cornerstone. He warns against honoring Him with lips while hearts are far away.
ot.a: Check whether your heart matches your words to God today.
ot.p: Father, let my heart be near you, not just my lips.

ot.t: "In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and trust is your strength."
ot.a: Find a quiet moment to rest and trust God.
ot.p: Lord, my strength is in quietness and trust.

ot.t: A king will reign in righteousness. God's people will see the King in His beauty.
ot.a: Imagine God's kingdom coming and pray for it today.
ot.p: Father, your kingdom come.

ot.t: The desert will bloom. Hezekiah spread the threat before God and was delivered.
ot.a: Bring a threatening situation to God in prayer.
ot.p: Lord, make my desert bloom and deliver me.

ot.t: Hezekiah was healed and given more years, but pride led him to show off his treasures.
ot.a: Use God's blessings to point to Him, not yourself.
ot.p: Father, let my life show your treasures, not mine.

ot.t: "Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength; they will soar on wings like eagles." "Do not fear, for I am with you."
ot.a: Hope in God when you are tired today.
ot.p: Lord, renew my strength as I wait on you.

ot.t: God's servant will not break a bruised reed. "When you pass through the waters, I will be with you."
ot.a: Bring a bruised part of your heart to God gently today.
ot.p: Father, you have called me by name; I am yours.

ot.t: "I am the first and the last; apart from me there is no God." Idols cannot save.
ot.a: Turn from one thing you rely on more than God.
ot.p: Lord, you alone are God. There is no other.

ot.t: Babylon fell in pride. God refines His people in the furnace of affliction.
ot.a: Trust that God is refining you, not destroying you.
ot.p: Father, refine me for your glory.

ot.t: "Can a mother forget her child? I will not forget you. I have engraved you on the palms of my hands."
ot.a: Remember today that God will never forget you.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that I am engraved on your hands.

ot.t: "He was pierced for our transgressions... by His wounds we are healed." "Come, all who are thirsty."
ot.a: Thank Jesus for His wounds that heal you.
ot.p: Jesus, by your wounds I am healed.

ot.t: "My house will be a house of prayer for all nations." God's arm is not too short to save.
ot.a: Pray for someone far from God; His arm can reach them.
ot.p: Lord, your arm is not too short to save.

ot.t: "Arise, shine, for your light has come." The Spirit anoints to bring good news to the poor.
ot.a: Shine God's light by doing good for someone today.
ot.p: Father, let your glory rise on me so I can shine.

ot.t: God is a Father who redeems. He will create new heavens and a new earth.
ot.a: Thank God for the hope of a new creation.
ot.p: Lord, you are our Father, and we are the clay.

ot.t: God looks to the humble who tremble at His word. Jeremiah was known before he was formed.
ot.a: Remember that God knew you and called you before you were born.
ot.p: Father, before I was formed, you knew me.

ot.t: Israel forsook the spring of living water for broken cisterns. "Return, faithless people."
ot.a: Name a "broken cistern" you rely on and return to God.
ot.p: Lord, you are the spring of living water.

ot.t: God searched for one person who acts justly and seeks truth.
ot.a: Be that one person today who acts justly.
ot.p: Father, make me one who seeks truth and justice.

ot.t: "Stand at the crossroads; ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is, and walk in it."
ot.a: At a decision today, choose God's tested path.
ot.p: Lord, show me the good way and help me walk in it.

ot.t: "Let not the wise boast in wisdom... but let them boast that they understand and know me."
ot.a: Boast today only in knowing God.
ot.p: Father, my greatest treasure is knowing you.

ot.t: God is the true and living God; idols are worthless. Judah broke the covenant.
ot.a: Worship God today as the living God, not a tradition.
ot.p: Lord, you are the true and living God.

ot.t: Jeremiah questioned God, and God answered. A ruined linen belt pictured a people who would not cling to God.
ot.a: Cling closely to God today.
ot.p: Father, I want to cling to you like a belt.

ot.t: In drought and grief, Jeremiah still prayed. God said He would bring His people back.
ot.a: Keep praying even when answers seem slow.
ot.p: Lord, you are my strength and my refuge in trouble.

ot.t: "Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord... like a tree planted by water." God is the Potter.
ot.a: Trust God like a tree with deep roots today.
ot.p: Father, you are the Potter; shape me as you will.

ot.t: Jeremiah suffered for speaking truth but said God's word was like fire in his bones.
ot.a: Do not stay silent about what God has put on your heart.
ot.p: Lord, let your word burn in me.

ot.t: God judged unjust kings and promised a righteous Branch, "The Lord Our Righteousness."
ot.a: Thank Jesus that He is your righteousness.
ot.p: Jesus, the Lord my Righteousness, thank you.

ot.t: God promised to give His people a heart to know Him. Judah would serve Babylon seventy years.
ot.a: Ask God for a heart to know Him more.
ot.p: Father, give me a heart to know that you are the Lord.

ot.t: Jeremiah faced death for speaking God's word. God was sovereign over the nations.
ot.a: Stand firm in truth even when it costs you.
ot.p: Lord, help me speak your word without fear.

ot.t: "I know the plans I have for you... plans to give you hope and a future." Seek God and find Him.
ot.a: Seek God with all your heart today.
ot.p: Father, I trust your plans for my future.

ot.t: "I have loved you with an everlasting love." God promised a new covenant written on hearts.
ot.a: Receive God's everlasting love today.
ot.p: Lord, write your law on my heart.

ot.t: Jeremiah bought a field in a city about to fall: "Nothing is too hard for you."
ot.a: Take a step of hope based on God's promise.
ot.p: Ah, Sovereign Lord, nothing is too hard for you.

ot.t: "Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things." The Recabites stayed faithful.
ot.a: Call to God today and listen for His answer.
ot.p: Father, I call to you. Show me great things.

ot.t: The king burned God's word, but God had it rewritten. His word cannot be destroyed.
ot.a: Thank God that His Word endures forever.
ot.p: Lord, your word cannot be burned or silenced.

ot.t: Jeremiah was thrown into a cistern, and a foreigner rescued him. Jerusalem fell as God said.
ot.a: Help rescue someone who is stuck.
ot.p: Father, thank you for unexpected rescuers.

ot.t: The remnant asked for God's guidance, then refused to obey it.
ot.a: Do not ask God for direction you are not willing to follow.
ot.p: Lord, I will obey what you show me.

ot.t: Fleeing to Egypt, the people kept old idols. God encouraged Baruch.
ot.a: Do not seek great things for yourself; seek God.
ot.p: Father, I seek you above great things for myself.

ot.t: God judges the nations, yet He promises to restore even some of them.
ot.a: Trust that God's justice is perfect over the world.
ot.p: Lord, you rule over all nations with justice.

ot.t: God's judgment reached many nations, but He also promised future restoration.
ot.a: Pray for a nation that is suffering today.
ot.p: Father, have mercy on the nations.

ot.t: Babylon would fall, and God would redeem His people. "Their Redeemer is strong."
ot.a: Trust your strong Redeemer today.
ot.p: Lord, my Redeemer is strong.

ot.t: God made the earth by His power and wisdom. Babylon's fall was certain.
ot.a: Worship God for His power over all creation.
ot.p: Father, you made the earth by your power and wisdom.

ot.t: Jerusalem fell, and Lamentations mourns honestly. God allows grief.
ot.a: Bring your grief honestly to God today.
ot.p: Lord, see my sorrow and comfort me.

ot.t: God's people lamented their sin and its cost, crying out from the heart.
ot.a: Pour out your heart to God like water.
ot.p: Father, I pour out my heart before you.

ot.t: "Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... His mercies are new every morning."
ot.a: Receive God's fresh mercy for today.
ot.p: Lord, great is your faithfulness. Your mercies are new this morning.

ot.t: "Restore us to yourself, Lord." Ezekiel saw God's glory even in exile.
ot.a: Ask God to restore you and show you His glory.
ot.p: Father, restore me to yourself.

ot.t: God sent Ezekiel to speak whether people listened or not. He ate God's scroll.
ot.a: Take God's Word in deeply today, and share it faithfully.
ot.p: Lord, let your Word be sweet in my mouth.

ot.t: God's judgment came because His people forgot Him. "Then you will know that I am the Lord."
ot.a: Remember God today before trouble forces you to.
ot.p: Father, let me know you in good times too.

ot.t: God showed Ezekiel idols hidden in the temple. His glory departed.
ot.a: Ask God to show you hidden idols in your heart.
ot.p: Lord, cleanse the hidden places of my heart.

ot.t: "I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them."
ot.a: Ask God for an undivided heart.
ot.p: Father, take my heart of stone and give me a heart of flesh.

ot.t: God condemned false prophets who said "peace" when there was no peace.
ot.a: Speak truth, not just comfortable words.
ot.p: Lord, make me honest and true.

ot.t: God loved Israel like an abandoned baby He rescued and adorned. Their unfaithfulness grieved Him.
ot.a: Remember what God rescued you from.
ot.p: Father, thank you for finding me and loving me.

ot.t: Each person is responsible for their own choices. God takes no pleasure in anyone's death. "Repent and live."
ot.a: Turn from one sin today and live.
ot.p: Lord, I repent and choose life.

ot.t: God acted for the sake of His name again and again, even when Israel rebelled.
ot.a: Thank God that His faithfulness is bigger than your failures.
ot.p: Father, act for the sake of your name in my life.

ot.t: God's judgment is like a sword. He calls His people to take His word seriously.
ot.a: Take one of God's warnings seriously today.
ot.p: Lord, help me fear you and obey.

ot.t: God looked for someone to stand in the gap, but found no one.
ot.a: Stand in the gap in prayer for someone today.
ot.p: Father, I will stand in the gap for others.

ot.t: God told Ezekiel not to mourn his wife publicly, as a sign. Obedience can be costly.
ot.a: Obey God in a costly area, trusting His purposes.
ot.p: Lord, give me grace when obedience is painful.

ot.t: Proud Tyre fell. Wealth and trade cannot secure a nation.
ot.a: Do not put your security in money today.
ot.p: Father, my security is in you, not in riches.

ot.t: The king of Tyre's pride pictures the fall of evil. God judges pride.
ot.a: Humble yourself in one area today.
ot.p: Lord, guard me from pride.

ot.t: Egypt's power fell like a great cedar. God brings down the proud.
ot.a: Remember that every power is under God.
ot.p: Father, every power is under your hand.

ot.t: God appointed Ezekiel a watchman to warn others.
ot.a: Lovingly warn someone heading the wrong way.
ot.p: Lord, make me a faithful watchman.

ot.t: God Himself will shepherd His sheep, seeking the lost and binding up the injured.
ot.a: Let God shepherd you today, and care for one "lost sheep."
ot.p: Father, you are my Shepherd. Seek and bind up the hurting through me.

ot.t: "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you."
ot.a: Ask God to renew your heart and spirit today.
ot.p: Lord, put your Spirit in me and move me to follow you.

ot.t: God breathed life into dry bones. Nothing is too dead for God.
ot.a: Bring a "dry bones" situation to God in prayer.
ot.p: Breath of God, breathe life into what is dry in me.

ot.t: Ezekiel saw a vision of a new temple. God plans to dwell with His people again.
ot.a: Thank God that He wants to dwell with you.
ot.p: Father, prepare me to be your dwelling.

ot.t: Every measurement mattered. God's holiness is perfect and precise.
ot.a: Honor God in the details of your day.
ot.p: Lord, be holy in the details of my life.

ot.t: God's glory returned to the temple. "This is where I will live forever."
ot.a: Invite God's glory into every part of your life.
ot.p: Father, let your glory fill my life.

ot.t: God called leaders to honesty and justice in worship and in daily life.
ot.a: Be honest in every transaction today.
ot.p: Lord, make me just and honest.

ot.t: A river flowed from the temple, bringing life everywhere it went. "The Lord is there."
ot.a: Let God's life flow through you to someone today.
ot.p: Father, let your river of life flow through me.

ot.t: Daniel resolved not to defile himself. God gave wisdom and revealed the king's dream.
ot.a: Make a quiet resolve to honor God in one area today.
ot.p: Lord, give me Daniel's resolve and wisdom.

ot.t: "Even if He does not deliver us, we will not bow." God was with them in the fire.
ot.a: Stay faithful in a pressure point today, whatever the outcome.
ot.p: Father, even if you do not, I will not bow. You are with me in the fire.

ot.t: Nebuchadnezzar was humbled until he praised God. Belshazzar was weighed and found wanting.
ot.a: Praise God humbly for who He is today.
ot.p: Lord, you rule over the kingdoms of men.

ot.t: Daniel prayed as usual, even facing the lions. God shut the lions' mouths. Daniel saw the Son of Man.
ot.a: Keep your prayer rhythm even when it costs you.
ot.p: Father, I will keep praying as I always do.

ot.t: Daniel confessed his people's sins and sought God. Gabriel brought an answer.
ot.a: Pray a prayer of confession for your community.
ot.p: Lord, we do not pray because we are righteous, but because of your mercy.

ot.t: An angel was delayed but came. Daniel was told, "Do not be afraid; you are highly esteemed."
ot.a: Keep praying; delays are not denials.
ot.p: Father, give me strength. I will not be afraid.

ot.t: "Those who are wise will shine like the stars." Hosea's marriage pictured God's faithful love.
ot.a: Lead someone toward righteousness today.
ot.p: Lord, let me shine and lead others to you.

ot.t: God promised to woo unfaithful Israel back. "Let us press on to know the Lord."
ot.a: Press on to know God more today.
ot.p: Father, I will press on to know you.

ot.t: God desires mercy, not sacrifice, and knowing Him more than offerings.
ot.a: Show mercy today instead of empty religion.
ot.p: Lord, I desire to know you, not just perform.

ot.t: "Break up your unplowed ground; it is time to seek the Lord." God loved Israel like a child.
ot.a: Break up hard ground in your heart and seek God.
ot.p: Father, you taught me to walk. I seek you again.

ot.t: "Return to the Lord." God promised to restore the years the locusts ate and pour out His Spirit.
ot.a: Return to God with all your heart today.
ot.p: Lord, restore what was lost and pour out your Spirit.

ot.t: God will judge the nations and be a refuge for His people. Amos began with judgment on neighbors.
ot.a: Pray for justice where you see wrongdoing.
ot.p: Father, be a refuge for your people.

ot.t: "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream." Seek God and live.
ot.a: Do one act of justice today.
ot.p: Lord, let justice roll through my life.

ot.t: God warned the complacent. A famine of hearing God's word is the worst famine.
ot.a: Hunger for God's Word today; do not take it for granted.
ot.p: Father, never let me grow complacent with your Word.

ot.t: God promised to restore David's house. Obadiah judged pride. Jonah ran from God.
ot.a: Stop running from what God has asked you to do.
ot.p: Lord, I will not run from you.

ot.t: Jonah prayed from the fish and obeyed. God showed mercy to Nineveh. Micah warned of judgment.
ot.a: Rejoice when God shows mercy to others.
ot.p: Father, give me your heart for the lost.

ot.t: "What does the Lord require? To act justly, love mercy and walk humbly with your God." A ruler will come from Bethlehem.
ot.a: Act justly, love mercy, walk humbly today.
ot.p: Lord, help me do justice, love mercy and walk humbly with you.

ot.t: God delights to show mercy and will cast our sins into the sea. "The Lord is good, a refuge in trouble."
ot.a: Thank God that He throws your sins into the depths of the sea.
ot.p: Father, who is a God like you, who pardons sin?

ot.t: God is slow to anger but just. "The righteous will live by faith."
ot.a: Live by faith in one area where you want to see before trusting.
ot.p: Lord, I will live by faith.

ot.t: "Though the fig tree does not bud... yet I will rejoice in the Lord." Zephaniah warned of the day of the Lord.
ot.a: Rejoice in God today even if circumstances are bare.
ot.p: Father, though everything fails, I will rejoice in you.

ot.t: "The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will rejoice over you with singing." Haggai said to rebuild God's house.
ot.a: Hear God singing over you today, and put His house first.
ot.p: Lord, thank you that you delight in me and sing over me.

ot.t: God called His people to return. He gave clean garments to the high priest. "Return to me, and I will return to you."
ot.a: Return to God today and receive His clean garments.
ot.p: Father, I return to you. Clothe me in your righteousness.

ot.t: "Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit." Do not despise small beginnings.
ot.a: Do one small thing for God today without despising it.
ot.p: Lord, not by my might, but by your Spirit.

ot.t: God will dwell in Jerusalem again. Your King comes, righteous and humble, riding on a donkey.
ot.a: Welcome Jesus as your humble King today.
ot.p: Jesus, my humble King, I welcome you.

ot.t: They will look on the one they pierced. A fountain will cleanse sin. The Lord will be King over all.
ot.a: Look to Jesus, the one who was pierced for you.
ot.p: Lord, open the fountain that cleanses my sin. Be King over all.

ot.t: God loves His people and calls for wholehearted worship. "Bring the whole tithe... and see if I will not open the windows of heaven." The sun of righteousness will rise.
ot.a: Give God your best and trust Him to provide.
ot.p: Father, I bring you my whole heart. Let the sun of righteousness rise with healing.

nt.t: Jesus' family tree includes broken, unexpected people. God brings His promises through real stories, and He is Immanuel, God with us.
nt.a: Thank God that your past does not disqualify you from His story.
nt.p: Immanuel, thank you that you are God with me.

nt.t: The wise men traveled far to worship Jesus; Herod saw Him as a threat. God protected His Son.
nt.a: Give Jesus your best worship today, like the magi did.
nt.p: Jesus, I bring you my worship and my treasures.

nt.t: John called people to repent and prepare. At Jesus' baptism, the Father said, "This is my beloved Son."
nt.a: Prepare your heart today by turning from one thing God shows you.
nt.p: Father, I repent and make room for Jesus.

nt.t: Jesus defeated temptation with Scripture: "Man shall not live by bread alone." Then He called fishermen to follow Him.
nt.a: Answer one temptation today with a verse of Scripture.
nt.p: Jesus, I will follow you, and your Word will be my defense.

nt.t: The Beatitudes turn the world upside down. Blessed are the poor in spirit. You are the salt and light of the world.
nt.a: Be salt and light in one specific place today.
nt.p: Lord, make me salt and light where you have placed me.

nt.t: Jesus goes to the heart: anger, lust and revenge. "Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you."
nt.a: Pray today for someone who has hurt you.
nt.p: Father, give me grace to love even my enemies.

nt.t: Give, pray and fast for God, not for applause. Jesus taught us to pray, "Our Father."
nt.a: Pray the Lord's Prayer slowly today, line by line.
nt.p: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.

nt.t: "Do not worry about tomorrow." Seek first God's kingdom, and He will provide.
nt.a: Hand one worry to God and seek His kingdom first today.
nt.p: Father, I seek your kingdom first. I trust you with tomorrow.

nt.t: Do not judge harshly. Ask, seek and knock. Build your life on the rock by doing what Jesus says.
nt.a: Act on one thing Jesus taught that you have only been hearing.
nt.p: Lord, help me build my life on the rock of your words.

nt.t: Jesus healed a leper, a servant and Peter's mother-in-law. Great faith moves Him.
nt.a: Bring someone who needs healing to Jesus in prayer.
nt.p: Jesus, I believe you can heal. Speak the word.

nt.t: Following Jesus costs something. He calmed the storm and freed the possessed.
nt.a: In your storm today, call on Jesus who commands the wind.
nt.p: Lord, even the winds and waves obey you. Calm my storm.

nt.t: Jesus forgave and healed a paralytic, called Matthew, and raised a girl. He came for sinners.
nt.a: Reach out to someone others avoid.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you that you came for sinners like me.

nt.t: "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few." Jesus sent His disciples out.
nt.a: Pray for workers, and be willing to be one.
nt.p: Lord of the harvest, send workers, and send me.

nt.t: Jesus warned of opposition but said, "Do not be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows."
nt.a: Remember today how much you are worth to God.
nt.p: Father, you count every hair on my head. I will not fear.

nt.t: Following Jesus means putting Him first. Whoever gives a cup of water in His name will be rewarded.
