nt.a: Do a small kindness today in Jesus' name.
nt.p: Jesus, you come first in my life.

nt.t: "Come to me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest."
nt.a: Bring your heaviest burden to Jesus today.
nt.p: Jesus, I come to you weary. Give me rest.

nt.t: Jesus is Lord of the Sabbath. Mercy matters more than rules.
nt.a: Choose mercy over rule-keeping in one situation.
nt.p: Lord, teach me that you desire mercy.

nt.t: Words reveal the heart. Whoever does God's will is Jesus' family.
nt.a: Guard your words today; let them reflect a good heart.
nt.p: Father, make my heart good so my words are good.

nt.t: The parable of the soils: God's Word bears fruit in a heart that receives it.
nt.a: Ask what kind of soil your heart is today.
nt.p: Lord, make my heart good soil for your Word.

nt.t: Worries and riches can choke the Word. God's kingdom grows like a mustard seed.
nt.a: Remove one worry that is choking your faith.
nt.p: Father, do not let the cares of life choke your Word in me.

nt.t: The kingdom is a treasure worth everything. Unbelief limited Jesus' miracles in His hometown.
nt.a: Value God above anything else today.
nt.p: Jesus, you are my treasure, worth everything.

nt.t: Jesus fed five thousand from a small offering. He came to the disciples on the water: "Take courage. It is I."
nt.a: Offer God what little you have and watch Him multiply it.
nt.p: Lord, take my little and make it enough.

nt.t: Peter walked on water until he looked at the waves. Jesus caught him. He cares about the heart, not empty tradition.
nt.a: Keep your eyes on Jesus, not on the waves.
nt.p: Jesus, when I sink, reach out and catch me.

nt.t: A Canaanite woman's persistent faith moved Jesus. He fed four thousand.
nt.a: Persist in prayer about something today.
nt.p: Lord, even crumbs from your table are enough for me.

nt.t: "Who do you say I am?" Peter answered, "You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."
nt.a: Tell Jesus today who He is to you.
nt.p: Jesus, you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

nt.t: Jesus said to take up our cross and follow Him. On the mountain, His glory was revealed.
nt.a: Ask what "taking up your cross" looks like today.
nt.p: Lord, I will deny myself and follow you.

nt.t: Faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains. Jesus paid the temple tax to avoid offense.
nt.a: Bring a "mountain" to God with small but real faith.
nt.p: Father, nothing is impossible with you.

nt.t: Become humble like a child. Forgive seventy times seven, as God has forgiven you.
nt.a: Forgive someone today, even if it is not the first time.
nt.p: Lord, you forgave me a debt I could never pay. Help me forgive.

nt.t: God designed marriage to be faithful. Jesus welcomed children: "The kingdom belongs to such as these."
nt.a: Bless a child or a marriage today with words or prayer.
nt.p: Jesus, let me come to you like a child.

nt.t: The rich young man walked away sad. With God, all things are possible.
nt.a: Ask what you might be holding onto more than Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, I give up what holds me back from you.

nt.t: God's grace is generous, like the vineyard owner. Jesus came not to be served but to serve.
nt.a: Serve someone today without expecting anything back.
nt.p: Jesus, you came to serve. Make me a servant.

nt.t: Jesus entered Jerusalem humbly and cleansed the temple. "My house will be a house of prayer."
nt.a: Make your life a house of prayer today.
nt.p: Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.

nt.t: Jesus cursed a fruitless fig tree and taught about faith. He warned leaders who rejected God's messengers.
nt.a: Ask God for fruit in your life, not just leaves.
nt.p: Lord, make my life fruitful for you.

nt.t: The rejected stone became the cornerstone. Everyone is invited to the wedding feast.
nt.a: Invite someone to church or to know Jesus.
nt.p: Jesus, you are my cornerstone.

nt.t: "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's." The greatest command is love.
nt.a: Give God what belongs to Him: your heart, time and trust.
nt.p: Father, I give you what is yours, all of me.

nt.t: Love God with all your heart and your neighbor as yourself. The greatest among you will be your servant.
nt.a: Love one neighbor practically today.
nt.p: Lord, help me love you and my neighbor well.

nt.t: Jesus warned against hypocrisy. He longed to gather Jerusalem like a hen gathers her chicks.
nt.a: Let your inner life match your outer life today.
nt.p: Jesus, cleanse the inside of my cup.

nt.t: Many will be deceived, but the gospel will be preached to all nations. Stand firm.
nt.a: Stand firm in faith in one area of pressure.
nt.p: Father, help me stand firm to the end.

nt.t: No one knows the day or hour of Jesus' return. Be alert.
nt.a: Live today as if Jesus could return.
nt.p: Lord, keep me ready for your coming.

nt.t: Be like the faithful servant, ready and working when the master returns.
nt.a: Do your work today as if Jesus were watching, because He is.
nt.p: Jesus, find me faithful when you come.

nt.t: Keep your lamp burning. Use the talents God gave you.
nt.a: Use one gift God has given you today.
nt.p: Father, help me be faithful with what you have entrusted to me.

nt.t: Whatever you do for the least, you do for Jesus.
nt.a: Help someone in need today as if serving Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, let me see you in the least of these.

nt.t: A woman poured perfume on Jesus. At the Last Supper, He gave His body and blood for us.
nt.a: Worship Jesus extravagantly today.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for your body broken and blood poured out for me.

nt.t: In Gethsemane, Jesus prayed, "Not my will, but yours." The disciples slept.
nt.a: Pray "Not my will, but yours" over one decision.
nt.p: Father, not my will, but yours be done.

nt.t: Jesus surrendered. Peter denied Him and wept bitterly.
nt.a: If you have failed Jesus, go to Him; He restores.
nt.p: Lord, when I deny you, bring me back.

nt.t: Judas was overcome with regret but did not return to Jesus. Pilate faced the crowd.
nt.a: Do not let guilt keep you from Jesus. Run to Him.
nt.p: Jesus, my guilt is never bigger than your grace.

nt.t: Jesus was mocked and crucified for us. He bore our shame.
nt.a: Thank Jesus today for bearing your shame.
nt.p: Jesus, you took my place on the cross.

nt.t: "My God, why have you forsaken me?" Jesus died; the curtain tore. The way to God is open.
nt.a: Come close to God today; the way is open.
nt.p: Lord, thank you that the curtain is torn and I can come near.

nt.t: He is risen! Jesus sends us to make disciples and promises, "I am with you always."
nt.a: Share the good news with one person this week.
nt.p: Risen Jesus, you are with me always.

nt.t: The good news begins. John prepared the way, and Jesus called, "Follow me."
nt.a: Follow Jesus today in one immediate step.
nt.p: Jesus, I will follow you.

nt.t: Jesus rose early to pray, then healed a leper with compassion.
nt.a: Start your day with prayer, like Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, teach me to rise and pray like you.

nt.t: Friends lowered a paralyzed man through a roof. Jesus forgave and healed him.
nt.a: Carry a friend to Jesus in prayer today.
nt.p: Jesus, I bring my friends to you.

nt.t: Jesus brings new wine. He healed on the Sabbath, doing good when others criticized.
nt.a: Do good today even if someone misunderstands.
nt.p: Lord, make me a new wineskin for your new work.

nt.t: Jesus chose the Twelve to be with Him. Those who do God's will are His family.
nt.a: Spend time just being with Jesus today.
nt.p: Jesus, I want to be with you.

nt.t: God's Word grows in good soil.
nt.a: Receive God's Word today with an open heart.
nt.p: Father, make me fruitful for you.

nt.t: Do not hide your light. Jesus calmed the storm: "Why are you afraid?"
nt.a: Trust Jesus in the storm you are facing.
nt.p: Lord, even the wind obeys you.

nt.t: Jesus freed a man from many demons. Jairus came, desperate for his daughter.
nt.a: Tell someone what Jesus has done for you.
nt.p: Jesus, no one is too far gone for you.

nt.t: A woman touched His cloak and was healed. Jesus raised Jairus' daughter: "Do not fear, only believe."
nt.a: Reach out to Jesus in faith today.
nt.p: Lord, I reach for you. Only believe.

nt.t: Jesus was rejected at home. He sent out the Twelve. John the Baptist was imprisoned.
nt.a: Do not let rejection stop you from faithfulness.
nt.p: Jesus, keep me faithful when I am misunderstood.

nt.t: John was martyred. Jesus had compassion and fed the five thousand.
nt.a: Bring your compassion into action today.
nt.p: Lord, give me your compassion for people.

nt.t: Jesus walked on water: "Take courage! It is I." He confronted empty tradition.
nt.a: Take courage today; Jesus is near.
nt.p: Jesus, I take courage. You are here.

nt.t: What defiles comes from the heart. Jesus healed a deaf man: "Be opened."
nt.a: Ask God to open your ears to hear Him.
nt.p: Lord, open my ears and my heart.

nt.t: Jesus fed four thousand and warned about hard hearts.
nt.a: Remember a time God provided and trust Him again.
nt.p: Father, soften my heart to remember your goodness.

nt.t: Peter confessed Jesus as Christ. "What good is it to gain the world and lose your soul?"
nt.a: Choose eternal things over temporary ones today.
nt.p: Jesus, I will not be ashamed of you.

nt.t: Jesus was transfigured. "Everything is possible for one who believes."
nt.a: Bring something that seems impossible to God.
nt.p: Lord, all things are possible for you.

nt.t: "I believe; help my unbelief!" The greatest is the servant of all.
nt.a: Pray honestly: "Help my unbelief."
nt.p: Lord, I believe; help my unbelief.

nt.t: God designed marriage for faithfulness. Jesus welcomed little children.
nt.a: Welcome the overlooked today.
nt.p: Jesus, let me receive your kingdom like a child.

nt.t: The rich man left sad. Jesus is going to the cross; the disciples argued about greatness.
nt.a: Release something that competes with Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, you are worth more than anything I own.

nt.t: "The Son of Man came to serve and to give His life as a ransom." Bartimaeus cried out and was healed.
nt.a: Cry out to Jesus boldly for your need.
nt.p: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

nt.t: Jesus entered Jerusalem, cleansed the temple and taught: "Have faith in God."
nt.a: Pray with faith and forgive anyone you hold something against.
nt.p: Father, I have faith in you, and I forgive.

nt.t: The rejected stone became the cornerstone. "Give to God what is God's."
nt.a: Give God your whole life today, not just part.
nt.p: Lord, I give you what belongs to you.

nt.t: God is the God of the living. Love God and neighbor. A poor widow gave everything.
nt.a: Give generously from your heart today, whatever the amount.
nt.p: Father, let me give like the widow.

nt.t: Jesus warned of trials and deception. The gospel must be preached.
nt.a: Stay alert to what is true.
nt.p: Lord, keep me from deception.

nt.t: "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away." Keep watch.
nt.a: Build your life on what will last.
nt.p: Jesus, your words will never pass away.

nt.t: A woman anointed Jesus. At the Last Supper He gave the bread and cup.
nt.a: Remember Jesus' sacrifice with gratitude today.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for your body and blood.

nt.t: Jesus prayed in anguish, "Not what I will, but what you will." The disciples fled.
nt.a: Stay with Jesus in your hard moments.
nt.p: Father, not my will but yours.

nt.t: Peter denied Jesus three times. Jesus stood silent before His accusers.
nt.a: Ask God to give you courage to stand for Him.
nt.p: Jesus, forgive my failures and make me brave.

nt.t: Pilate released Barabbas instead of Jesus. Jesus took the guilty man's place.
nt.a: Remember that Jesus took your place.
nt.p: Jesus, you took my place.

nt.t: Jesus died, the curtain tore, and a centurion said, "Surely this was the Son of God."
nt.a: Declare today who Jesus is.
nt.p: Surely you are the Son of God.

nt.t: He is risen! "Go into all the world and preach the gospel."
nt.a: Share the good news with someone this week.
nt.p: Risen Lord, send me with your good news.

nt.t: God answered Zechariah's long prayer. John would prepare the way.
nt.a: Do not give up on a long-time prayer.
nt.p: Father, you hear my prayers, even the old ones.

nt.t: Mary said, "I am the Lord's servant. May it be to me as you have said."
nt.a: Say yes to God in one area today.
nt.p: Lord, I am your servant. Let it be as you say.

nt.t: Elizabeth and Mary rejoiced together. "My soul glorifies the Lord."
nt.a: Praise God for what He has done for you.
nt.p: My soul magnifies you, Lord.

nt.t: Zechariah praised God for His mercy: "The rising sun will come to us from heaven."
nt.a: Thank God for His tender mercy today.
nt.p: Father, thank you for your tender mercy and light.

nt.t: Jesus was born in a manger. Angels announced, "Good news of great joy for all people."
nt.a: Share good news with joy today.
nt.p: Glory to God in the highest!

nt.t: Simeon and Anna waited and saw God's salvation. Young Jesus was in His Father's house.
nt.a: Wait patiently for God's promises.
nt.p: Lord, my eyes have seen your salvation.

nt.t: John called for real change: share, be honest, be content.
nt.a: Make one practical change that shows real repentance.
nt.p: Father, let my life show fruit of repentance.

nt.t: At Jesus' baptism, the Father said, "You are my Son, whom I love." Jesus' line goes back to Adam.
nt.a: Hear the Father's love over you today.
nt.p: Father, thank you that I am loved in Christ.

nt.t: Jesus overcame temptation with Scripture, then announced His mission: good news to the poor and freedom for captives.
nt.a: Bring good news to someone who is struggling.
nt.p: Spirit of the Lord, anoint me to bring good news.

nt.t: Jesus was rejected at home but healed many. He went to quiet places to pray.
nt.a: Find a quiet place to pray today.
nt.p: Lord, I come away to be with you.

nt.t: At Jesus' word, Peter let down the nets and caught many fish. "From now on you will fish for people."
nt.a: Obey Jesus even when it does not make sense.
nt.p: Lord, at your word I will let down the nets.

nt.t: Jesus came to call sinners to repentance. New wine needs new wineskins.
nt.a: Make room for God to do something new.
nt.p: Jesus, make me new.

nt.t: Jesus is Lord of the Sabbath. He prayed all night before choosing the Twelve. Blessed are the poor.
nt.a: Pray before your next big decision.
nt.p: Father, guide my choices as I pray.

nt.t: "Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you." Build on the rock.
nt.a: Do good to someone who has been difficult.
nt.p: Lord, give me a heart that loves my enemies.

nt.t: The centurion's faith amazed Jesus. Jesus raised a widow's son with compassion.
nt.a: Trust Jesus' word for your need today.
nt.p: Lord, just say the word.

nt.t: A sinful woman wept at Jesus' feet. Whoever is forgiven much loves much.
nt.a: Thank Jesus for how much He has forgiven you.
nt.p: Jesus, I have been forgiven much. Let me love much.

nt.t: Women supported Jesus' ministry. The good soil hears the Word and holds it fast.
nt.a: Hold onto God's Word with patience today.
nt.p: Father, let your Word take root and bear fruit in me.

nt.t: Let your light shine. Jesus calmed the storm and freed a tormented man.
nt.a: Let Jesus calm your storm today.
nt.p: Lord, you have authority over every storm.

nt.t: Jesus healed a bleeding woman and raised Jairus' daughter: "Do not be afraid; just believe."
nt.a: Choose faith over fear today.
nt.p: Jesus, I will not fear. I believe.

nt.t: Jesus sent the Twelve and fed the five thousand. Peter declared, "You are the Christ of God."
nt.a: Tell God who Jesus is to you today.
nt.p: You are the Christ of God.

nt.t: Take up your cross daily. Jesus was transfigured, and the Father said, "Listen to Him."
nt.a: Listen to Jesus today before other voices.
nt.p: Father, I will listen to your Son.

nt.t: The least among you is the greatest. Following Jesus means not looking back.
nt.a: Do not look back at what Jesus called you from.
nt.p: Lord, I will follow you without looking back.

nt.t: Jesus sent out seventy-two. "Love the Lord your God... and your neighbor as yourself."
nt.a: Love God and one neighbor intentionally today.
nt.p: Father, help me love you with everything.

nt.t: The Good Samaritan showed mercy. Mary chose the better part, sitting at Jesus' feet.
nt.a: Sit at Jesus' feet for a few minutes today.
nt.p: Lord, I choose the better part, time with you.

nt.t: Jesus taught us to pray and to keep asking. The Father gives the Holy Spirit to those who ask.
nt.a: Ask God for more of His Spirit today.
nt.p: Father, give me your Holy Spirit.

nt.t: Jesus warned against hypocrisy and empty religion.
nt.a: Let your heart match your actions today.
nt.p: Lord, make me honest before you.

nt.t: Do not fear people; fear God. Watch out for greed.
nt.a: Notice where greed shows up, and choose generosity.
nt.p: Father, my life is not in my possessions.

nt.t: "Do not worry... seek His kingdom." Where your treasure is, your heart will be.
nt.a: Put your treasure in heaven by giving today.
nt.p: Lord, be my treasure.

nt.t: Much is required from those given much. Jesus came to bring division as well as peace.
nt.a: Be faithful with what God has given you.
nt.p: Father, help me be faithful with all you have given.

nt.t: Repent while there is time. Jesus healed a bent woman on the Sabbath.
nt.a: Repent of one thing today; do not wait.
nt.p: Lord, straighten what is bent in me.

nt.t: Enter through the narrow door. The humble will be exalted.
nt.a: Take the lower seat today in humility.
nt.p: Jesus, teach me humility.

nt.t: Invite those who cannot repay you. Count the cost of following Jesus.
nt.a: Do something kind for someone who cannot repay you.
nt.p: Lord, I count the cost and choose you.

nt.t: God searches for the lost sheep and the lost coin. The prodigal came to his senses and went home.
nt.a: If you have wandered, come home to the Father today.
nt.p: Father, I am coming home.

nt.t: The father ran to his son and celebrated. Do not be the older brother who refuses grace.
nt.a: Celebrate someone's return to God.
nt.p: Father, thank you for running to me.

nt.t: You cannot serve God and money. The rich man ignored Lazarus at his gate.
nt.a: Notice someone at your "gate" who needs help.
nt.p: Lord, open my eyes to those at my gate.

nt.t: Forgive often. Increase our faith. The one healed leper returned to give thanks.
nt.a: Go back and thank God for something specific.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you. I return to give you thanks.

nt.t: Be ready for the coming of the Son of Man, like lightning.
nt.a: Live ready today.
nt.p: Lord, keep me ready for your return.

nt.t: Always pray and do not give up. God hears the humble who say, "Have mercy on me, a sinner."
nt.a: Pray persistently and humbly today.
nt.p: God, have mercy on me, a sinner.

nt.t: A blind beggar cried out and received sight. Jesus stops for those who call Him.
nt.a: Cry out to Jesus with your need.
nt.p: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

nt.t: Zacchaeus met Jesus and was changed. "The Son of Man came to seek and save the lost." Be faithful with what you have.
nt.a: Make one change today that shows Jesus has changed you.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for seeking and saving me.

nt.t: Jesus wept over Jerusalem and cleansed the temple.
nt.a: Pray for your city with Jesus' compassion.
nt.p: Lord, give me tears for my city.

nt.t: Jesus' authority comes from God. Give to God what is God's.
nt.a: Give God the first place in your life today.
nt.p: Father, I give you what is yours.

nt.t: God is the God of the living. Jesus warned against religious show.
nt.a: Seek God's approval, not people's.
nt.p: Lord, free me from performing for others.

nt.t: The widow gave all she had. Stand firm through trials; not a hair will perish.
nt.a: Give from the heart and stand firm.
nt.p: Father, by standing firm I will gain life.

nt.t: Jesus will return. "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not." Pray always.
nt.a: Stay watchful in prayer today.
nt.p: Lord, keep me watchful and praying.

nt.t: Jesus gave the bread and cup. The greatest is the one who serves.
nt.a: Serve someone humbly today.
nt.p: Jesus, I remember your sacrifice.

nt.t: Jesus prayed for Peter not to fail. In Gethsemane, "Not my will, but yours."
nt.a: Thank Jesus that He prays for you.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for praying for me.

nt.t: Jesus healed the servant's ear even while being arrested. Peter denied Him and wept.
nt.a: Show kindness even when you are mistreated.
nt.p: Lord, make me gentle like you.

nt.t: Pilate found no fault, but the crowd shouted, "Crucify Him."
nt.a: Stand with Jesus today even if others do not.
nt.p: Jesus, I will not deny you.

nt.t: "Father, forgive them." Jesus promised paradise to a dying thief.
nt.a: Forgive someone today as Jesus forgave.
nt.p: Father, forgive them, and help me forgive.

nt.t: Jesus died, and the women found the tomb empty: "He is not here; He has risen!"
nt.a: Celebrate the risen Jesus today.
nt.p: He is risen! Thank you, Lord.

nt.t: On the road to Emmaus, Jesus walked with two discouraged disciples.
nt.a: Know that Jesus walks with you in disappointment.
nt.p: Lord, walk with me on my road.

nt.t: Their hearts burned as He opened the Scriptures. Jesus promised power from on high.
nt.a: Ask Jesus to open the Scriptures to you.
nt.p: Jesus, open my mind to understand your Word.

nt.t: "In the beginning was the Word." Jesus is God, full of grace and truth. To all who receive Him, He gives the right to become God's children.
nt.a: Receive Jesus afresh today as God's child.
nt.p: Jesus, Word made flesh, thank you for making me God's child.

nt.t: "Behold, the Lamb of God." Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. "Come and see."
nt.a: Invite someone to "come and see" Jesus.
nt.p: Lamb of God, I follow you.

nt.t: Jesus turned water into wine. "Do whatever He tells you."
nt.a: Do whatever Jesus tells you today.
nt.p: Lord, I will do whatever you tell me.

nt.t: Jesus cleansed the temple with zeal. Nicodemus came at night: "You must be born again."
nt.a: Thank God for new birth by His Spirit.
nt.p: Spirit of God, thank you for new life.

nt.t: "For God so loved the world..." "He must increase; I must decrease."
nt.a: Let Jesus increase in one area today.
nt.p: Jesus, you must increase, and I must decrease.

nt.t: Jesus met a Samaritan woman at a well and offered living water.
nt.a: Talk with someone others avoid.
nt.p: Jesus, give me your living water.

nt.t: True worshipers worship in spirit and truth. The fields are ripe for harvest.
nt.a: Worship God honestly today, in spirit and truth.
nt.p: Father, I worship you in spirit and truth.

nt.t: Many believed because of the woman's testimony. Jesus healed an official's son from afar.
nt.a: Share your simple testimony with someone.
nt.p: Lord, I believe your word, even from a distance.

nt.t: Jesus healed a man waiting 38 years: "Do you want to get well?"
nt.a: Answer Jesus honestly: what do you need Him to heal?
nt.p: Jesus, I want to be made well.

nt.t: Scripture testifies about Jesus. Seek God's praise, not people's.
nt.a: Read Scripture looking for Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, let me seek your approval above all.

nt.t: Jesus fed five thousand from a boy's lunch. "Work for food that endures to eternal life."
nt.a: Give Jesus what you have, however small.
nt.p: Jesus, take my little and bless it.

nt.t: "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry."
nt.a: Come to Jesus with your hunger today.
nt.p: Jesus, you are my bread of life.

nt.t: Many left, but Peter said, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life."
nt.a: Choose to stay close to Jesus when it is hard.
nt.p: Lord, to whom else would I go?

nt.t: Jesus taught with authority. Whoever chooses to do God's will will know the truth.
nt.a: Obey what you know, and God will show you more.
nt.p: Father, I choose to do your will.

nt.t: "Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink." Rivers of living water flow from within.
nt.a: Ask the Spirit to flow through you today.
nt.p: Jesus, I am thirsty. Fill me.

nt.t: "Neither do I condemn you; go and sin no more." "I am the light of the world."
nt.a: Receive Jesus' mercy and walk in His light.
nt.p: Jesus, light of the world, I follow you.

nt.t: Jesus' testimony is true. "The truth will set you free."
nt.a: Ask God to show you a truth that sets you free.
nt.p: Lord, your truth sets me free.

nt.t: "If the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed." "Before Abraham was, I AM."
nt.a: Live in your freedom today.
nt.p: Jesus, I AM, you have set me free indeed.

nt.t: Jesus healed a man born blind so God's work could be shown.
nt.a: Look for how God might use your hardship.
nt.p: Lord, display your works in my life.

nt.t: "I was blind, but now I see." Spiritual blindness is refusing to see.
nt.a: Tell someone simply what Jesus has done for you.
nt.p: Jesus, I was blind, but now I see.

nt.t: "I am the Good Shepherd; I lay down my life for the sheep." "I came that they may have life abundantly."
nt.a: Listen for the Shepherd's voice today.
nt.p: Good Shepherd, I hear your voice.

nt.t: No one can snatch Jesus' sheep from His hand.
nt.a: Rest in the security of Jesus' hand.
nt.p: Jesus, I am safe in your hand.

nt.t: Lazarus died, and Jesus waited. "Your brother will rise again."
nt.a: Trust Jesus' timing even when it seems late.
nt.p: Lord, your timing is never late.

nt.t: "I am the resurrection and the life." Jesus wept, then called Lazarus out of the tomb.
nt.a: Bring something that seems dead to Jesus.
nt.p: Jesus, resurrection and life, call me out.

nt.t: Leaders plotted against Jesus. Mary poured out costly perfume in worship.
nt.a: Give Jesus something costly in worship today.
nt.p: Jesus, you are worth my most precious things.

nt.t: Crowds welcomed Jesus as King. "Unless a grain of wheat falls and dies, it remains alone."
nt.a: Let go of something so God can bring fruit.
nt.p: Lord, I die to self so you can bring life.

nt.t: "When I am lifted up, I will draw all people to myself." Walk in the light while you have it.
nt.a: Lift up Jesus today in your words.
nt.p: Jesus, draw people to yourself through me.

nt.t: Jesus washed His disciples' feet: "I have given you an example."
nt.a: Serve someone humbly today, even in a small way.
nt.p: Jesus, teach me to wash feet.

nt.t: "A new command I give you: love one another. As I have loved you."
nt.a: Show love to a fellow believer today.
nt.p: Lord, help me love as you have loved me.

nt.t: "Let not your hearts be troubled. I am the way, the truth and the life." The Spirit will come.
nt.a: Bring your troubled heart to Jesus.
nt.p: Jesus, you are the way, the truth and the life.

nt.t: "I am the vine; you are the branches. Apart from me you can do nothing." Abide in Him.
nt.a: Abide in Jesus today through prayer and His Word.
nt.p: Lord, I abide in you. Bear fruit through me.

nt.t: The Spirit will guide you into all truth. The world may hate you, but He is with you.
nt.a: Ask the Spirit to guide you into truth today.
nt.p: Holy Spirit, guide me into all truth.

nt.t: "In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world."
nt.a: Take heart in whatever trouble you face.
nt.p: Jesus, you have overcome the world.

nt.t: Jesus prayed for His disciples and for all who would believe, that they would be one.
nt.a: Pray for unity among believers today.
nt.p: Father, make us one as you and Jesus are one.

nt.t: Jesus was arrested. Peter denied Him.
nt.a: Ask God for courage to stand with Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, make me brave.

nt.t: "My kingdom is not of this world." Pilate asked, "What is truth?"
nt.a: Live today as a citizen of Jesus' kingdom.
nt.p: Jesus, your kingdom is my true home.

nt.t: Jesus was crowned with thorns and crucified as "King of the Jews."
nt.a: Worship Jesus as your King today.
nt.p: Jesus, you wore thorns for me.

nt.t: "It is finished." Jesus completed the work of salvation.
nt.a: Rest today in Jesus' finished work.
nt.p: Jesus, it is finished. I am free.

nt.t: Mary met the risen Jesus. Thomas believed: "My Lord and my God!"
nt.a: Tell Jesus today, "My Lord and my God."
nt.p: My Lord and my God!

nt.t: Jesus restored Peter: "Do you love me? Feed my sheep."
nt.a: Answer Jesus today: "Yes, Lord, you know I love you."
nt.p: Lord, you know I love you.

nt.t: Jesus promised the Spirit's power and ascended. The disciples prayed together.
nt.a: Pray with other believers this week.
nt.p: Holy Spirit, fill me with power.

nt.t: The Spirit came like fire at Pentecost. People heard God's wonders in their own languages.
nt.a: Ask the Holy Spirit to fill you today.
nt.p: Spirit of God, fall fresh on me.

nt.t: Peter preached Jesus crucified and risen. God fulfilled His promises.
nt.a: Share Jesus' story boldly.
nt.p: Lord, give me boldness like Peter.

nt.t: "Repent and be baptized." The early church devoted themselves to teaching, fellowship, prayer and breaking bread.
nt.a: Engage in Christian fellowship this week.
nt.p: Father, make me devoted to you and your people.

nt.t: "Silver and gold I do not have, but what I have I give you. In the name of Jesus, walk."
nt.a: Give someone what you have: your time, prayer, encouragement.
nt.p: Jesus, use what I have to bless others.

nt.t: Peter and John spoke boldly. "We cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard."
nt.a: Do not stay silent about Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, I cannot help but speak about you.

nt.t: The church prayed for boldness, and the place shook. Believers shared everything.
nt.a: Pray for boldness and share generously.
nt.p: Father, give me boldness and a generous heart.

nt.t: God judged dishonesty. The apostles said, "We must obey God rather than men."
nt.a: Obey God today even if people disagree.
nt.p: Lord, I will obey you above all.

nt.t: Gamaliel warned not to fight against God. Deacons were chosen to serve. Stephen was full of grace.
nt.a: Serve faithfully today in a practical way.
nt.p: Father, fill me with grace and power.

nt.t: Stephen retold God's faithfulness from Abraham to Joseph.
nt.a: Remember God's faithfulness through history.
nt.p: Lord, you have always been faithful.

nt.t: God raised up Moses even when his own people rejected him.
nt.a: Trust God's call even when others do not understand.
nt.p: Father, help me be faithful when rejected.

nt.t: Stephen saw Jesus standing and forgave his killers as he died.
nt.a: Forgive someone who has hurt you today.
nt.p: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit, and do not hold this sin against them.

nt.t: Persecution scattered the church, and the gospel spread. Simon tried to buy God's power.
nt.a: Trust God to use scattering for good.
nt.p: Lord, use even hardship to spread your good news.

nt.t: Philip explained Isaiah to an Ethiopian official, who believed and was baptized.
nt.a: Be ready to explain your faith to someone today.
nt.p: Father, lead me to people who are searching.

nt.t: Saul met Jesus on the road and was transformed. Ananias obeyed despite fear.
nt.a: Pray for someone you think could never change.
nt.p: Jesus, no one is too far for you.

nt.t: Peter healed Aeneas and raised Dorcas, a woman known for good works.
nt.a: Be known for doing good today.
nt.p: Lord, let my life be full of good works.

nt.t: God showed Peter that He shows no favoritism. Cornelius was seeking God.
nt.a: Reach out across a cultural line today.
nt.p: Father, you show no favoritism. Neither will I.

nt.t: The Holy Spirit fell on the Gentiles. God's gift is for everyone.
nt.a: Celebrate that the gospel is for all people.
nt.p: Lord, thank you that your Spirit is for everyone.

nt.t: The church welcomed the Gentiles. Barnabas encouraged them. They were first called Christians.
nt.a: Be a Barnabas: encourage someone today.
nt.p: Father, make me an encourager.

nt.t: The church prayed earnestly, and an angel freed Peter from prison.
nt.a: Pray earnestly for someone today.
nt.p: Lord, you open prison doors.

nt.t: Herod's pride brought judgment. The Spirit sent Barnabas and Saul on mission.
nt.a: Ask what the Spirit may be calling you to.
nt.p: Holy Spirit, set me apart for your work.

nt.t: Paul preached that God kept His promise through Jesus.
nt.a: Share how God kept a promise to you.
nt.p: Father, thank you for your faithfulness through Jesus.

nt.t: Forgiveness of sins is proclaimed through Jesus. The disciples were filled with joy despite opposition.
nt.a: Choose joy in the Spirit today.
nt.p: Lord, fill me with joy and the Holy Spirit.

nt.t: Paul was stoned and got up again. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom."
nt.a: Keep going after a setback.
nt.p: Father, strengthen me through hardship.

nt.t: The church gathered to decide: salvation is by grace, not law.
nt.a: Thank God that you are saved by grace alone.
nt.p: Lord, thank you that it is by grace.

nt.t: The church avoided burdening Gentiles. Paul and Barnabas disagreed and parted.
nt.a: Handle disagreement with grace today.
nt.p: Father, help me disagree without bitterness.

nt.t: God redirected Paul to Macedonia. Lydia's heart was opened.
nt.a: Be open to God redirecting your plans.
nt.p: Lord, open doors and close doors as you will.

nt.t: Paul and Silas sang in prison. The jailer asked, "What must I do to be saved?"
nt.a: Praise God in a hard place today.
nt.p: Father, I will praise you even in chains.

nt.t: The Bereans checked Scripture daily. Paul spoke to the thinkers of Athens.
nt.a: Check what you hear against God's Word.
nt.p: Lord, make me a Berean, eager for your Word.

nt.t: "In Him we live and move and have our being." Paul served as a tentmaker.
nt.a: Remember God is near you wherever you are.
nt.p: Father, in you I live and move.

nt.t: Priscilla and Aquila explained the way of God more accurately to Apollos.
nt.a: Help someone grow in their faith with gentle truth.
nt.p: Lord, use me to strengthen others.

nt.t: Believers received the Spirit. People burned their magic books.
nt.a: Get rid of anything that pulls you from God.
nt.p: Father, I let go of what does not honor you.

nt.t: A riot broke out in Ephesus. Paul kept preaching through the night.
nt.a: Stay faithful even when it is uncomfortable.
nt.p: Lord, keep me faithful in turmoil.

nt.t: "I consider my life worth nothing, if only I may finish the race." "It is more blessed to give than to receive."
nt.a: Give something today.
nt.p: Father, help me finish my race well.

nt.t: Paul was ready to suffer for Jesus. "The Lord's will be done."
nt.a: Surrender a hard situation to God's will.
nt.p: Lord, your will be done.

nt.t: Paul was arrested but used it to share his testimony.
nt.a: Look for a chance to share your story.
nt.p: Father, use my trials as a platform.

nt.t: Paul told his conversion story. God turned a persecutor into a preacher.
nt.a: Tell someone how you came to Jesus.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for changing my life.

nt.t: Paul stood firm before the council.
nt.a: Stand firm in truth with respect today.
nt.p: Lord, give me courage before others.

nt.t: Jesus stood by Paul: "Take courage." God foiled the plot.
nt.a: Take courage; Jesus stands with you.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for standing by me.

nt.t: Paul spoke about faith, righteousness and judgment. Felix delayed.
nt.a: Do not delay responding to God.
nt.p: Father, I respond to you today, not later.

nt.t: Paul appealed to Caesar. God was guiding him to Rome.
nt.a: Trust God's bigger plan in delays.
nt.p: Lord, you are guiding my path.

nt.t: Paul defended his hope in the resurrection.
nt.a: Share your hope in Jesus with someone.
nt.p: Father, my hope is in the resurrection.

nt.t: Paul was not disobedient to the heavenly vision.
nt.a: Obey what God has shown you.
nt.p: Lord, I will not disobey your call.

nt.t: In the storm, all hope seemed lost.
nt.a: Hold on to God when the storm is long.
nt.p: Father, you are with me in the storm.

nt.t: "Take heart, for I have faith in God that it will happen as I have been told." All were saved.
nt.a: Encourage others with your faith today.
nt.p: Lord, I believe it will be as you said.

nt.t: On Malta, Paul was unharmed by a snake and healed many.
nt.a: Bless the people around you, wherever you are.
nt.p: Father, make me a blessing in unexpected places.

nt.t: Paul preached boldly in Rome. "I am not ashamed of the gospel."
nt.a: Do not be ashamed of Jesus today.
nt.p: Lord, I am not ashamed of your gospel.

nt.t: God's power and nature are clearly seen in creation. Exchanging the truth for a lie leads to ruin.
nt.a: Thank God for His creation and honor Him as God.
nt.p: Father, I worship you, not created things.

nt.t: God's kindness leads us to repentance. He judges fairly.
nt.a: Let God's kindness move you to change.
nt.p: Lord, your kindness leads me to repentance.

nt.t: No one is righteous on their own. All need grace.
nt.a: Humble yourself before God today.
nt.p: Father, I have no righteousness of my own.

nt.t: All have sinned, but we are justified freely by His grace through Jesus.
nt.a: Rest in God's free gift today.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for justifying me freely.

nt.t: Abraham believed God, and it was credited as righteousness.
nt.a: Believe God's promise over your circumstances.
nt.p: Father, I believe you.

nt.t: We have peace with God. Suffering produces perseverance, character and hope. God showed His love while we were still sinners.
nt.a: Thank God for His love that came first.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for loving me while I was still a sinner.

nt.t: We died to sin and live to God. Offer yourself to Him.
nt.a: Offer one part of your life to God today.
nt.p: Father, I offer myself to you.

nt.t: The struggle with sin is real. "Who will rescue me? Thanks be to God through Jesus!"
nt.a: Bring your struggle to Jesus honestly.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for rescuing me.

nt.t: There is no condemnation in Christ. The Spirit gives life and makes us God's children.
nt.a: Receive freedom from condemnation today.
nt.p: Abba, Father, thank you that I am your child.

nt.t: Nothing can separate us from God's love. In all things God works for the good of those who love Him.
nt.a: Remind yourself: nothing can separate me from His love.
nt.p: Lord, nothing can separate me from your love.

nt.t: God's mercy is His choice. His purposes stand.
nt.a: Trust God's sovereignty today.
nt.p: Father, I trust your mercy and wisdom.

nt.t: "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord... you will be saved." How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news.
nt.a: Share good news with someone.
nt.p: Jesus is Lord!

nt.t: God has not rejected His people; a remnant remains by grace.
nt.a: Thank God for His faithfulness to you.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for your grace.

nt.t: "Oh, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God!"
nt.a: Praise God for His wisdom today.
nt.p: To you be the glory forever.

nt.t: "Offer your bodies as living sacrifices... be transformed by the renewing of your mind." Love sincerely.
nt.a: Let God renew one way you think today.
nt.p: Father, transform me by renewing my mind.

nt.t: Respect authority. Love fulfills the law. Do not judge others over disputable things.
nt.a: Show love to someone you disagree with.
nt.p: Lord, let love guide how I treat others.

nt.t: Do not cause others to stumble. Pursue what makes for peace.
nt.a: Choose peace over winning an argument.
nt.p: Father, help me build others up.

nt.t: "May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in Him." Accept one another.
nt.a: Welcome someone as Christ welcomed you.
nt.p: God of hope, fill me with joy and peace.

nt.t: Paul greeted many coworkers by name, men and women who served faithfully.
nt.a: Thank someone who serves with you.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for the people who serve beside me.

nt.t: Avoid those who cause division. God's faithfulness keeps you strong to the end.
nt.a: Pray for peace in your community.
nt.p: Father, keep me strong to the end.

nt.t: God chose the foolish things to shame the wise. Christ is our wisdom.
nt.a: Boast only in the Lord today.
nt.p: Lord, you are my wisdom and righteousness.

nt.t: God reveals His wisdom by His Spirit. God gives the growth.
nt.a: Ask the Spirit to teach you today.
nt.p: Holy Spirit, reveal God's wisdom to me.

nt.t: Build on the foundation of Christ. You are God's temple.
nt.a: Treat your life as God's dwelling today.
nt.p: Lord, I am your temple. Make me holy.

nt.t: Be faithful as servants of Christ. God judges the heart. Deal with sin in the church.
nt.a: Be faithful in what God has entrusted to you.
nt.p: Father, find me faithful.

nt.t: Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit. You were bought at a price.
nt.a: Honor God with your body today.
nt.p: Lord, I was bought at a price. I honor you.

nt.t: Marriage is sacred. Live the life God has assigned.
nt.a: Be content where God has placed you.
nt.p: Father, help me honor you in my relationships.

nt.t: Serve the Lord with undivided devotion.
nt.a: Give God your undivided attention for a moment today.
nt.p: Lord, I give you undivided devotion.

nt.t: Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
nt.a: Choose love over being right today.
nt.p: Father, let love guide my knowledge.

nt.t: "I have become all things to all people so that I might save some." Run to win.
nt.a: Adapt to serve someone better today.
nt.p: Lord, help me run to win the prize.

nt.t: God provides a way out of temptation. Do everything for God's glory.
nt.a: Take God's way out of a temptation today.
nt.p: Father, do everything for your glory.

nt.t: Follow Christ's example and honor others.
nt.a: Honor someone in your community today.
nt.p: Lord, help me follow you.

nt.t: At the Lord's Supper, examine yourself and remember Jesus.
nt.a: Remember Jesus' sacrifice thoughtfully today.
nt.p: Jesus, I remember you.

nt.t: We are one body with many parts. Every member matters.
nt.a: Use your gift to serve the body.
nt.p: Lord, use my part in your body.

nt.t: "Love is patient, love is kind... love never fails."
nt.a: Practice patience and kindness today.
nt.p: Father, make me patient and kind.

nt.t: Pursue love and desire spiritual gifts that build others up.
nt.a: Speak words that strengthen someone.
nt.p: Lord, help me build up your church.

nt.t: God is a God of peace and order.
nt.a: Bring order and peace to one situation.
nt.p: Father, you are the God of peace.

nt.t: Christ died for our sins and rose again. Our faith is not in vain.
nt.a: Thank Jesus for His resurrection.
nt.p: Risen Christ, my faith is not in vain.

nt.t: "Death has been swallowed up in victory." Be steadfast; your labor is not in vain.
nt.a: Keep serving faithfully; it is not in vain.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for victory over death.

nt.t: Be watchful, stand firm, be strong. Do everything in love.
nt.a: Do one task today in love.
nt.p: Father, let all I do be done in love.

nt.t: God comforts us so we can comfort others.
nt.a: Comfort someone today with the comfort you have received.
nt.p: God of all comfort, comfort others through me.

nt.t: God's promises are "Yes" in Christ. We are the aroma of Christ.
nt.a: Let your life spread the fragrance of Jesus.
nt.p: Lord, all your promises are yes in Jesus.

nt.t: We are being transformed into His image with ever-increasing glory. Where the Spirit is, there is freedom.
nt.a: Spend time beholding Jesus today.
nt.p: Spirit of the Lord, transform me.

nt.t: We have this treasure in jars of clay. Our troubles are light compared to eternal glory.
nt.a: Fix your eyes on what is unseen.
nt.p: Father, my troubles are light compared to your glory.

nt.t: If anyone is in Christ, they are a new creation. We are ambassadors of reconciliation.
nt.a: Be an ambassador for Christ today.
nt.p: Lord, I am a new creation.

nt.t: Now is the day of salvation. Do not be unequally yoked.
nt.a: Make today count for God.
nt.p: Father, now is the time. Help me live fully for you.

nt.t: Godly sorrow brings repentance. The Macedonians gave generously in poverty.
nt.a: Give generously today.
nt.p: Lord, give me a generous heart.

nt.t: "God loves a cheerful giver." He is able to make all grace abound.
nt.a: Give cheerfully today.
nt.p: Father, thank you for your indescribable gift.

nt.t: We take every thought captive to obey Christ.
nt.a: Take one negative thought captive today.
nt.p: Lord, I take every thought captive to you.

nt.t: Paul feared believers would be led astray from sincere devotion.
nt.a: Keep your devotion to Christ simple and sincere.
nt.p: Jesus, keep me devoted to you.

nt.t: Paul boasted in his weakness and sufferings.
nt.a: Stop hiding your weakness and let God be strong.
nt.p: Lord, I boast in my weakness.

nt.t: "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness."
nt.a: Bring your weakness to God and receive His grace.
nt.p: Father, your grace is enough for me.

nt.t: The gospel comes from God, not people. Paul was called by grace.
nt.a: Remember God's grace in calling you.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for calling me by grace.

nt.t: "I have been crucified with Christ... Christ lives in me."
nt.a: Let Christ live through you today.
nt.p: Jesus, I live by faith in you.

nt.t: We receive the Spirit by faith, not works. Christ redeemed us from the curse.
nt.a: Rest in faith, not performance.
nt.p: Father, thank you that it is by faith.

nt.t: In Christ, we are all children of God. There is neither Jew nor Gentile.
nt.a: Treat others as equals in Christ.
nt.p: Lord, we are all one in Christ Jesus.

nt.t: We are no longer slaves but God's children and heirs.
nt.a: Live as God's child, not a slave.
nt.p: Abba, Father, I am your child.

nt.t: "It is for freedom that Christ has set us free." Walk by the Spirit; bear the fruit of the Spirit.
nt.a: Show one fruit of the Spirit today.
nt.p: Holy Spirit, grow your fruit in me.

nt.t: Carry each other's burdens. Do not grow weary in doing good.
nt.a: Help carry someone's burden today.
nt.p: Father, I will not grow weary in doing good.

nt.t: God chose us, adopted us, and sealed us with the Spirit. Paul prayed for spiritual wisdom.
nt.a: Thank God for every spiritual blessing in Christ.
nt.p: Father, thank you for choosing and adopting me.

nt.t: We were dead, but God made us alive. Saved by grace through faith. We are His workmanship.
nt.a: Do a good work God has prepared for you.
nt.p: Lord, I am your workmanship.

nt.t: God's love is wide, long, high and deep. He can do more than we ask or imagine.
nt.a: Ask God for something big today.
nt.p: Father, you can do more than I ask or imagine.

nt.t: Live worthy of your calling with humility and patience. Each part helps the body grow.
nt.a: Be patient with someone today.
nt.p: Lord, help me walk worthy of your calling.

nt.t: Put off the old self, put on the new. Do not let the sun go down on your anger. Be kind and forgiving.
nt.a: Resolve a conflict before the day ends.
nt.p: Father, make me kind and forgiving.

nt.t: Walk as children of light. Be filled with the Spirit. Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
nt.a: Make the most of your time today.
nt.p: Lord, fill me with your Spirit.

nt.t: Put on the full armor of God. Pray at all times in the Spirit.
nt.a: Put on each piece of God's armor in prayer.
nt.p: Father, I put on your armor today.

nt.t: He who began a good work in you will complete it. Paul's chains advanced the gospel.
nt.a: Trust God to finish what He started in you.
nt.p: Lord, complete your good work in me.

nt.t: "To live is Christ and to die is gain." Have the mind of Christ, who humbled Himself.
nt.a: Humble yourself to serve someone.
nt.p: Jesus, give me your mind and humility.

nt.t: God works in you to will and to act. Shine like stars. Timothy and Epaphroditus served faithfully.
nt.a: Do everything without grumbling today.
nt.p: Father, work in me to do your will.

nt.t: Paul counted everything as loss compared to knowing Christ. "I press on toward the goal."
nt.a: Press on toward God's goal today.
nt.p: Lord, I want to know you.

nt.t: "Rejoice in the Lord always." "Do not be anxious about anything." "I can do all things through Christ."
nt.a: Replace one worry with prayer and thanksgiving.
nt.p: Father, guard my heart with your peace.

nt.t: Christ is the image of the invisible God; in Him all things hold together.
nt.a: Let Jesus hold your life together today.
nt.p: Jesus, in you all things hold together.

nt.t: You are complete in Christ. Do not be captured by empty philosophy.
nt.a: Root yourself in Christ today.
nt.p: Lord, I am complete in you.

nt.t: Set your mind on things above. Put on compassion, kindness and humility. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
nt.a: Forgive someone as the Lord forgave you.
nt.p: Father, clothe me with compassion.

nt.t: Put on love. Let the peace of Christ rule your heart. Whatever you do, work for the Lord.
nt.a: Do your work today as for the Lord.
nt.p: Lord, let your peace rule my heart.

nt.t: The Thessalonians turned to God from idols and became an example.
nt.a: Let your faith be a good example today.
nt.p: Father, make my faith known for good.

nt.t: Paul shared his life, not just the gospel. He longed to see them stand firm.
nt.a: Share your life with someone, not just words.
nt.p: Lord, make me gentle like a mother caring for children.

nt.t: Live to please God. Lead a quiet life. Jesus will return; encourage one another with this.
nt.a: Encourage someone with the hope of Jesus' return.
nt.p: Father, thank you for the hope of being with you forever.

nt.t: "Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances."
nt.a: Pray short prayers throughout your day.
nt.p: Lord, I give thanks in all things.

nt.t: May God sanctify you through and through. He is faithful.
nt.a: Trust God's faithfulness to make you holy.
nt.p: Father, sanctify me completely.

nt.t: Stand firm and hold on to the teachings. God gives eternal encouragement.
nt.a: Stand firm in truth today.
nt.p: Lord, strengthen me in every good word and deed.

nt.t: Do not grow weary in doing good. The goal of instruction is love from a pure heart.
nt.a: Do good today even if you feel tired.
nt.p: Father, give me love from a pure heart.

nt.t: Christ came to save sinners. Pray for all people and leaders.
nt.a: Pray for your leaders today.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for saving me, a sinner.

nt.t: Leaders should have godly character.
nt.a: Grow in one area of godly character.
nt.p: Father, build character in me.

nt.t: Train yourself in godliness. Set an example in speech, conduct, love and faith.
nt.a: Be an example in your speech today.
nt.p: Lord, help me be an example for others.

nt.t: Care for widows and honor faithful elders.
nt.a: Help someone who is vulnerable.
nt.p: Father, help me care for the vulnerable.

nt.t: Godliness with contentment is great gain. Fight the good fight of faith.
nt.a: Practice contentment today.
nt.p: Lord, teach me contentment.

nt.t: God gave us a spirit of power, love and self-control. Be strong in grace.
nt.a: Face a fear with God's power today.
nt.p: Father, you have not given me a spirit of fear.

nt.t: Present yourself as a worker approved by God. Pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace.
nt.a: Handle God's Word carefully today.
nt.p: Lord, make me a worker approved by you.

nt.t: All Scripture is God-breathed. Paul finished the race and kept the faith.
nt.a: Read Scripture with fresh attention.
nt.p: Father, help me finish well.

nt.t: The Lord stood by Paul. Leaders must be faithful.
nt.a: Thank God for standing with you.
nt.p: Lord, you stood by me.

nt.t: God's grace teaches us to say no to ungodliness. Live self-controlled lives.
nt.a: Practice self-control today.
nt.p: Father, train me by your grace.

nt.t: God saved us because of His mercy, not our works.
nt.a: Thank God for His mercy.
nt.p: Lord, you saved me by your mercy.

nt.t: Paul asked Philemon to welcome Onesimus as a brother.
nt.a: Welcome someone back with grace.
nt.p: Father, help me receive others as you received me.

nt.t: Jesus is the radiance of God's glory. He became like us to help us.
nt.a: Thank Jesus for understanding your struggles.
nt.p: Jesus, radiance of God's glory, thank you.

nt.t: "Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts." Encourage one another daily.
nt.a: Encourage someone today.
nt.p: Lord, keep my heart soft to your voice.

nt.t: God's Word is living and active. Approach the throne of grace with confidence.
nt.a: Bring your need boldly to God.
nt.p: Father, I come to your throne of grace.

nt.t: Jesus learned obedience through suffering. Grow toward maturity.
nt.a: Take one step in spiritual growth today.
nt.p: Lord, help me grow up in you.

nt.t: God will not forget your work and love. Hope is an anchor for the soul.
nt.a: Hold on to hope today.
nt.p: Father, you are the anchor of my soul.

nt.t: Jesus is a priest forever who lives to intercede for us.
nt.a: Remember that Jesus is praying for you.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for interceding for me.

nt.t: Jesus mediates a better covenant. God writes His law on our hearts.
nt.a: Ask God to write His Word on your heart.
nt.p: Lord, write your law on my heart.

nt.t: Christ entered heaven once for all with His own blood.
nt.a: Rest in Jesus' once-for-all sacrifice.
nt.p: Jesus, thank you for your blood.

nt.t: We can enter God's presence with confidence. Do not give up meeting together.
nt.a: Connect with your church this week.
nt.p: Father, I draw near with a true heart.

nt.t: Do not throw away your confidence. Faith is confidence in what we hope for.
nt.a: Hold on to your confidence in God.
nt.p: Lord, give me faith that pleases you.

nt.t: By faith, heroes endured. They looked ahead to God's promises.
nt.a: Take one step of faith today.
nt.p: Father, make me faithful like those before me.

nt.t: "Fix your eyes on Jesus." God disciplines those He loves.
nt.a: Look to Jesus in your struggle today.
nt.p: Jesus, author and perfecter of my faith.

nt.t: We have come to a kingdom that cannot be shaken. "I will never leave you nor forsake you."
nt.a: Remember God's promise never to leave you.
nt.p: Lord, you will never leave me.

nt.t: Offer a sacrifice of praise. The God of peace equips us for every good work.
nt.a: Praise God out loud today.
nt.p: Father, equip me for every good work.

nt.t: Consider trials joy; they produce endurance. Ask God for wisdom. Be doers of the Word.
nt.a: Do one thing God's Word tells you.
nt.p: Lord, give me wisdom in my trials.

nt.t: Do not show favoritism. Faith without works is dead.
nt.a: Put your faith into action today.
nt.p: Father, let my faith show in my actions.

nt.t: The tongue is powerful. Wisdom from above is pure and peaceable.
nt.a: Watch your words carefully today.
nt.p: Lord, tame my tongue.

nt.t: Submit to God, resist the devil, draw near to God.
nt.a: Draw near to God today.
nt.p: Father, I draw near to you.

nt.t: Be patient. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful.
nt.a: Pray for someone who is sick or struggling.
nt.p: Lord, hear my prayer for others.

nt.t: We have a living hope through Jesus' resurrection. Be holy as He is holy.
nt.a: Live in hope today.
nt.p: Father, thank you for my living hope.

nt.t: You are a chosen people, a royal priesthood. Jesus left us an example.
nt.a: Declare God's praises today.
nt.p: Lord, I am chosen and yours.

nt.t: Always be ready to explain your hope with gentleness and respect.
nt.a: Be ready to share why you hope in Jesus.
nt.p: Father, help me share my hope gently.

nt.t: Love covers a multitude of sins. Use your gifts to serve others.
nt.a: Serve someone with your gifts today.
nt.p: Lord, help me use my gifts for others.

nt.t: Cast your anxieties on God because He cares. He has given us everything for godliness.
nt.a: Cast one worry on God today.
nt.p: Father, I cast my cares on you.

nt.t: God's Word is a light shining in a dark place. Beware of false teachers.
nt.a: Pay attention to God's Word today.
nt.p: Lord, your Word is my light.

nt.t: God is patient, not wanting anyone to perish. Grow in grace and knowledge.
nt.a: Pray for someone who does not know Jesus.
nt.p: Father, thank you for your patience.

nt.t: God is light. If we confess our sins, He is faithful to forgive.
nt.a: Confess one sin and receive forgiveness.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for cleansing me.

nt.t: Jesus is our advocate. Whoever loves their brother lives in the light.
nt.a: Love a fellow believer today.
nt.p: Jesus, my advocate, thank you.

nt.t: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called His children.
nt.a: Remember today that you are God's child.
nt.p: Father, thank you for calling me your child.

nt.t: God is love. Perfect love drives out fear.
nt.a: Let God's love calm your fears.
nt.p: Lord, your perfect love drives out my fear.

nt.t: Our faith overcomes the world. God hears us when we pray according to His will.
nt.a: Pray with confidence today.
nt.p: Father, thank you that you hear me.

nt.t: Walk in truth and love.
nt.a: Show truth with love today.
nt.p: Lord, let me walk in truth and love.

nt.t: Imitate what is good. Contend for the faith.
nt.a: Do something good that others can imitate.
nt.p: Father, keep me faithful to the truth.

nt.t: God is able to keep you from stumbling. Jesus holds the keys of death.
nt.a: Rest in God's power to keep you.
nt.p: Lord, you are able to keep me from falling.

nt.t: Ephesus left its first love. Smyrna was faithful in suffering.
nt.a: Return to your first love for Jesus.
nt.p: Jesus, I return to my first love.

nt.t: Hold fast to what you have. Jesus searches hearts.
nt.a: Ask God to search your heart today.
nt.p: Lord, search my heart and keep me faithful.

nt.t: Jesus stands at the door and knocks. Around God's throne, worship never stops.
nt.a: Open the door of your heart to Jesus.
nt.p: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty.

nt.t: The Lamb who was slain is worthy. He redeemed people from every nation.
nt.a: Worship Jesus as worthy today.
nt.p: Worthy is the Lamb who was slain.

nt.t: The seals bring judgment. God hears the cries of His people.
nt.a: Bring your cries to God, who hears.
nt.p: Lord, how long? I trust you.

nt.t: A great multitude from every nation worships God. He will wipe away every tear.
nt.a: Picture heaven's worship and join in.
nt.p: Salvation belongs to our God and to the Lamb.

nt.t: Judgment came, yet many still did not repent.
nt.a: Respond to God with a soft heart today.
nt.p: Father, keep my heart from hardening.

nt.t: God's witnesses were faithful. "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord."
nt.a: Live as a faithful witness today.
nt.p: Lord, your kingdom is coming.

nt.t: They overcame by the blood of the Lamb and the word of their testimony.
nt.a: Share your testimony with someone.
nt.p: Jesus, I overcome by your blood.

nt.t: Evil demands worship, but God's people endure faithfully.
nt.a: Refuse to worship anything but God.
nt.p: Lord, give me faithful endurance.

nt.t: The redeemed sing a new song. "Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord."
nt.a: Sing a song of praise today.
nt.p: Father, I give you a new song.

nt.t: "Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty." God's judgments are just.
nt.a: Praise God for His justice.
nt.p: Just and true are your ways.

nt.t: Babylon represents the world's seduction. The Lamb will overcome.
nt.a: Resist the pull of the world today.
nt.p: Lord, the Lamb will overcome.

nt.t: "Come out of her, my people." Worldly riches will vanish.
nt.a: Separate yourself from one worldly pull.
nt.p: Father, my treasure is in you.

nt.t: The wedding of the Lamb has come. Jesus returns as King of kings.
nt.a: Worship Jesus as King of kings.
nt.p: Hallelujah! The Lord our God reigns.

nt.t: Satan is defeated. Those whose names are in the Book of Life are safe.
nt.a: Thank God your name is written in heaven.
nt.p: Lord, thank you for writing my name in your book.

nt.t: God makes all things new. He will dwell with His people and wipe away every tear.
nt.a: Let the hope of heaven strengthen you.
nt.p: Father, make all things new.

nt.t: The river of life flows. "Behold, I am coming soon." "Come, Lord Jesus."
nt.a: Live today longing for Jesus' return.
nt.p: Come, Lord Jesus.

ps.t: The blessed person delights in God's Word and grows like a tree planted by streams of water.
ps.a: Meditate on one verse today, morning and evening.
ps.p: Lord, plant me by your streams and make me fruitful.

ps.t: The nations rage, but God has set His King on His holy hill. He laughs at those who plot against Him.
ps.a: When the news is overwhelming, remember who sits on the throne.
ps.p: Father, you reign above every plot and plan.

ps.t: "Kiss the Son... blessed are all who take refuge in Him."
ps.a: Take refuge in Jesus in one anxious area today.
ps.p: Jesus, I take refuge in you.

ps.t: David, fleeing his son, said, "You, Lord, are a shield around me... I lie down and sleep."
ps.a: Lie down tonight trusting God to sustain you.
ps.p: Lord, you are my shield and the lifter of my head.

ps.t: "You have filled my heart with greater joy... In peace I will lie down and sleep."
ps.a: Thank God for His joy, which runs deeper than circumstances.
ps.p: Father, you alone make me dwell in safety.

ps.t: "In the morning, Lord, you hear my voice; I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly."
ps.a: Lay your requests before God this morning, then watch for His answer.
ps.p: Lord, in the morning I lay my requests before you.

ps.t: God's people enter His house by His great love. He surrounds the righteous with favor like a shield.
ps.a: Enter today aware of God's unfailing love.
ps.p: Father, spread your protection over me.

ps.t: David cried out in distress, and "the Lord has heard my weeping."
ps.a: Bring your tears to God; He hears them.
ps.p: Lord, you have heard my cry for mercy.

ps.t: David asked God to search him and judge rightly.
ps.a: Ask God to search your motives today.
ps.p: Lord, search me and save me.

ps.t: God is a righteous judge who tests hearts and minds.
ps.a: Trust God to judge fairly in a situation where you feel wronged.
ps.p: Father, you test hearts. Make mine pure.

ps.t: Evil falls into its own trap. "I will give thanks to the Lord because of His righteousness."
ps.a: Give thanks today for God's justice.
ps.p: Lord, I praise you for your righteousness.

ps.t: "What is man that you are mindful of him?" God crowned humans with glory and honor.
ps.a: Look at the night sky and remember your worth to God.
ps.p: Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth.

ps.t: "I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds."
ps.a: Tell someone one wonderful thing God has done.
ps.p: Father, I praise you with all my heart.

ps.t: "Those who know your name trust in you, for you have never forsaken those who seek you."
ps.a: Trust God today because He has never forsaken you.
ps.p: Lord, you are a stronghold in times of trouble.

ps.t: God does not forget the cry of the afflicted. The needy will not always be forgotten.
ps.a: Pray for someone who feels forgotten.
ps.p: Father, you never forget the needy.

ps.t: "Why, Lord, do you stand far off?" Even honest questions are a form of prayer.
ps.a: Bring your hard question to God honestly.
ps.p: Lord, even when you feel far, I keep talking to you.

ps.t: The wicked think God does not see, but He does.
ps.a: Live today knowing God sees everything.
ps.p: Father, you see all things. Keep me honest.

ps.t: "You, God, see the trouble of the afflicted... You are the helper of the fatherless."
ps.a: Help someone vulnerable today.
ps.p: Lord, you hear the desire of the afflicted.

ps.t: "In the Lord I take refuge." When foundations shake, God is still on His throne.
ps.a: When things feel unstable, look up to God's throne.
ps.p: Father, you are on your throne. I take refuge in you.

ps.t: People's words can be empty, but "the words of the Lord are flawless, like silver refined seven times."
ps.a: Trust God's words over people's words today.
ps.p: Lord, your words are pure and true.

ps.t: "How long, Lord?" David moved from lament to trust: "I trust in your unfailing love."
ps.a: Move one worry from "how long" to "I trust you."
ps.p: Father, I trust in your unfailing love.

ps.t: "The fool says in his heart, there is no God." God looks for those who seek Him.
ps.a: Seek God intentionally today.
ps.p: Lord, I want to be one who seeks you.

ps.t: Who may dwell with God? Those who walk blamelessly, speak truth and keep their promises.
ps.a: Keep a promise even when it costs you.
ps.p: Father, help me walk with integrity.

ps.t: "You make known to me the path of life; in your presence there is fullness of joy."
ps.a: Spend time in God's presence for joy today.
ps.p: Lord, you are my portion; I have no good apart from you.

ps.t: David asked God to hear his honest prayer.
ps.a: Pray honestly about one thing today.
ps.p: Father, hear my cry.

ps.t: "Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings."
ps.a: Rest in being precious to God today.
ps.p: Lord, hide me in the shadow of your wings.

ps.t: "I love you, Lord, my strength. The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer."
ps.a: Tell God you love Him today.
ps.p: I love you, Lord, my strength.

ps.t: "In my distress I called to the Lord... He heard my voice."
ps.a: Call on God in your distress today.
ps.p: Father, you hear me when I call.

ps.t: "He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters."
ps.a: Thank God for a time He rescued you.
ps.p: Lord, thank you for drawing me out of deep waters.

ps.t: "He brought me out into a spacious place; He rescued me because He delighted in me."
ps.a: Remember that God delights in you.
ps.p: Father, thank you that you delight in me.

ps.t: "With the faithful you show yourself faithful." "You, Lord, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light."
ps.a: Ask God to turn one dark area into light.
ps.p: Lord, keep my lamp burning.

ps.t: "It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure."
ps.a: Ask God for strength for today's tasks.
ps.p: Father, arm me with strength.

ps.t: God gave David victory over his enemies.
ps.a: Give God credit for every victory today.
ps.p: Lord, every victory belongs to you.

ps.t: "The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock!"
ps.a: Praise God as your living Rock.
ps.p: The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock.

ps.t: "The heavens declare the glory of God." Creation speaks of Him without words.
ps.a: Look at the sky today and praise God.
ps.p: Father, the heavens declare your glory.

ps.t: "The law of the Lord is perfect, refreshing the soul." "May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight."
ps.a: Pray Psalm 19:14 over your words today.
ps.p: Lord, may my words and thoughts please you.

ps.t: "May He give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed."
ps.a: Pray this blessing over someone today.
ps.p: Father, answer us when we call.

ps.t: "Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God."
ps.a: Notice what you are tempted to trust and turn to God.
ps.p: Lord, I trust in your name.

ps.t: God's presence brings joy. He will defeat every enemy.
ps.a: Rejoice in God's strength today.
ps.p: Father, I rejoice in your strength.

ps.t: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" Jesus prayed this on the cross. "You are holy."
ps.a: Bring your feeling of abandonment to God; He understands.
ps.p: Lord, even when I feel forsaken, you are holy.

ps.t: "From birth I was cast on you... Do not be far from me."
ps.a: Remember that God has held you since birth.
ps.p: Father, you have been my God since birth.

ps.t: This psalm vividly describes the crucifixion. Jesus suffered for us.
ps.a: Thank Jesus for what He endured for you.
ps.p: Jesus, thank you for suffering in my place.

ps.t: "I will declare your name to my brothers and sisters; in the assembly I will praise you."
ps.a: Praise God with others this week.
ps.p: Lord, I will praise you in the congregation.

ps.t: "He has not despised the suffering of the afflicted one." All the earth will turn to the Lord.
ps.a: Remember that God does not ignore suffering.
ps.p: Father, the whole earth will worship you.

ps.t: "The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing... Surely goodness and mercy will follow me."
ps.a: Read Psalm 23 slowly and rest in it.
ps.p: Lord, you are my shepherd. I lack nothing.

ps.t: "The earth is the Lord's." Lift up your heads, that the King of glory may come in.
ps.a: Welcome Jesus as King of glory into your day.
ps.p: Lift up your heads; the King of glory is here.

ps.t: "Show me your ways, Lord, teach me your paths... my hope is in you all day long."
ps.a: Ask God to teach you His way in one decision.
ps.p: Lord, show me your ways.

ps.t: "Remember your mercy... Do not remember the sins of my youth." God guides the humble.
ps.a: Receive God's forgiveness for old sins.
ps.p: Father, remember me according to your love.

ps.t: "The Lord confides in those who fear Him." David asked God to turn to him in loneliness.
ps.a: Bring your loneliness to God today.
ps.p: Lord, turn to me and be gracious to me.

ps.t: "May integrity and uprightness protect me." "Test me, Lord, and try me."
ps.a: Ask God to test and strengthen your integrity.
ps.p: Father, examine my heart and mind.

ps.t: David loved God's house and walked in integrity.
ps.a: Love God's presence above all today.
ps.p: Lord, I love the house where you live.

ps.t: "The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?"
ps.a: Face a fear today with this verse.
ps.p: Lord, you are my light. Whom shall I fear?

ps.t: "Your face, Lord, I will seek." "Teach me your way."
ps.a: Seek God's face, not just His hand, today.
ps.p: Father, I will seek your face.

ps.t: "I remain confident: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. Wait for the Lord."
ps.a: Wait on God with courage today.
ps.p: Lord, I will wait for you.

ps.t: "The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and He helps me."
ps.a: Trust God to help you today.
ps.p: Father, you are my strength and shield.

ps.t: "The voice of the Lord is powerful... The Lord gives strength and blesses His people with peace."
ps.a: Listen for God's voice over the noise today.
ps.p: Lord, give me strength and peace.

ps.t: "I will exalt you, Lord, for you lifted me out of the depths."
ps.a: Praise God for lifting you up.
ps.p: Father, you lifted me out of the depths.

ps.t: "Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning." "You turned my wailing into dancing."
ps.a: Hold on; joy is coming.
ps.p: Lord, turn my mourning into dancing.

ps.t: "Into your hands I commit my spirit." Jesus prayed this on the cross.
ps.a: Commit your day into God's hands.
ps.p: Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.

ps.t: "I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction."
ps.a: Remember that God sees your pain.
ps.p: Lord, you know the anguish of my soul.

ps.t: "I trust in you, Lord; I say, 'You are my God.' My times are in your hands."
ps.a: Trust God with your schedule and future today.
ps.p: Father, my times are in your hands.

ps.t: "Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord."
ps.a: Encourage someone who is struggling.
ps.p: Lord, I hope in you. Strengthen my heart.

ps.t: "Blessed is the one whose sin is forgiven." When David confessed, God forgave him.
ps.a: Confess one sin to God and be free.
ps.p: Father, thank you for forgiving my sin.

ps.t: "Sing joyfully to the Lord... the earth is full of His unfailing love."
ps.a: Sing a song of praise today.
ps.p: Lord, the earth is full of your love.

ps.t: God spoke, and it came to be. His plans stand firm forever.
ps.a: Trust God's plans over your own today.
ps.p: Father, your plans stand firm forever.

ps.t: "Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord." His eyes are on those who hope in His love.
ps.a: Pray for your nation today.
ps.p: Lord, your eyes are on those who hope in you.

ps.t: "We wait in hope for the Lord; He is our help and our shield." "I will extol the Lord at all times."
ps.a: Praise God at all times today.
ps.p: I will bless you, Lord, at all times.

ps.t: "I sought the Lord, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears." "Taste and see that the Lord is good."
ps.a: Taste God's goodness by thanking Him for three things.
ps.p: Lord, I have tasted and seen that you are good.

ps.t: "Those who seek the Lord lack no good thing." Turn from evil, seek peace and pursue it.
ps.a: Pursue peace in one relationship today.
ps.p: Father, help me seek and pursue peace.

ps.t: "The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit."
ps.a: Reach out to someone who is hurting.
ps.p: Lord, you are close to the brokenhearted.

ps.t: David asked God to fight for him against those who attacked without cause.
ps.a: Ask God to defend you instead of defending yourself.
ps.p: Father, contend with those who contend with me.

ps.t: David prayed for his enemies when they were sick, even though they repaid him with evil.
ps.a: Pray for someone who has been unkind to you.
ps.p: Lord, help me return good for evil.

ps.t: When attacked, David brought it to God instead of retaliating.
ps.a: Bring injustice to God today.
ps.p: Father, you see it all.

ps.t: "Let those who delight in my vindication shout for joy... my tongue will proclaim your righteousness."
ps.a: Declare God's goodness all day.
ps.p: Lord, my tongue will speak of your righteousness.

ps.t: "Your love, Lord, reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies."
ps.a: Picture how vast God's love is.
ps.p: Father, your love reaches to the heavens.

ps.t: "With you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light."
ps.a: Drink from God's fountain of life today.
ps.p: Lord, in your light I see light.

ps.t: "Do not fret... Trust in the Lord and do good... Delight yourself in the Lord... Commit your way to Him."
ps.a: Commit one plan to God today.
ps.p: Father, I delight in you and commit my way to you.

ps.t: "The meek will inherit the land." God laughs at the wicked, for their day is coming.
ps.a: Choose meekness instead of pushing your way.
ps.p: Lord, teach me meekness.

ps.t: "Better the little the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked."
ps.a: Be content with what you have today.
ps.p: Father, I am content in you.

ps.t: "The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in Him; though he may stumble, he will not fall."
ps.a: Trust God to hold you when you stumble.
ps.p: Lord, you uphold me with your hand.

ps.t: "The law of their God is in their hearts; their feet do not slip."
ps.a: Memorize a short verse today.
ps.p: Father, put your law in my heart.

ps.t: "Hope in the Lord and keep His way." "The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord."
ps.a: Keep God's way patiently today.
ps.p: Lord, you are my stronghold in trouble.

ps.t: David felt the weight of his sin and suffering. "All my longings lie open before you, Lord."
ps.a: Bring your heavy heart honestly to God.
ps.p: Father, my longings are open before you.

ps.t: Abandoned by friends, David waited for God: "Lord, I wait for you; you will answer."
ps.a: Wait on God's answer today.
ps.p: Lord, I wait for you; you will answer.

ps.t: "Lord, do not forsake me... Come quickly to help me, my Lord and my Savior."
ps.a: Call on God quickly in your need.
ps.p: Come quickly to help me, Lord.

ps.t: "Show me, Lord, my life's end and the number of my days... my hope is in you."
ps.a: Remember that life is short; invest it in what lasts.
ps.p: Father, my hope is in you.

ps.t: David asked God to save him from his sins and hear his prayer.
ps.a: Ask God to hear your prayer and forgive.
ps.p: Lord, hear my prayer and listen to my cry.

ps.t: "I waited patiently for the Lord... He put a new song in my mouth."
ps.a: Sing a new song of praise today.
ps.p: Father, you have put a new song in my mouth.

ps.t: "I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart."
ps.a: Choose God's will in one decision today.
ps.p: Lord, I delight to do your will.

ps.t: "Blessed is the one who has regard for the weak; the Lord delivers him in times of trouble."
ps.a: Show care for someone weak today.
ps.p: Father, help me care for the weak.

ps.t: Even a close friend betrayed David, but God upheld him.
ps.a: Trust God when people disappoint you.
ps.p: Lord, you uphold me in my integrity.

ps.t: "As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, O God." "Why, my soul, are you downcast? Put your hope in God."
ps.a: Speak hope to your own soul today.
ps.p: My soul thirsts for you, O God.

ps.t: "By day the Lord directs His love, at night His song is with me."
ps.a: Let God's song be with you tonight.
ps.p: Father, your love is with me day and night.

ps.t: "Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me." "Put your hope in God."
ps.a: Ask God's light to lead you today.
ps.p: Lord, send your light and truth to lead me.

ps.t: "It was not by their sword that they won the land... it was your right hand."
ps.a: Credit God for your successes.
ps.p: Father, my victories come from your hand.

ps.t: Even when God's people suffered, they kept trusting Him.
ps.a: Keep trusting God when things do not make sense.
ps.p: Lord, I will boast in you all day long.

ps.t: "For your sake we face death all day long." Faith holds on through suffering.
ps.a: Hold on to God in suffering.
ps.p: Father, I am yours, even in trouble.

ps.t: "Awake, Lord! Rise up!" Then a royal song begins: "You are the most excellent of men."
ps.a: Praise Jesus as the most excellent King.
ps.p: Lord, rise up and help us.

ps.t: The King rides out in majesty for truth, humility and justice. "Your throne, O God, will last forever."
ps.a: Worship Jesus as the eternal King.
ps.p: Your throne, O God, lasts forever.

ps.t: "The King is enthralled by your beauty; honor Him, for He is your Lord."
ps.a: Give yourself fully to Jesus today.
ps.p: Jesus, I honor you as my Lord.

ps.t: "God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. Therefore we will not fear."
ps.a: Choose not to fear today.
ps.p: Father, you are my refuge and strength.

ps.t: "Be still, and know that I am God."
ps.a: Take five minutes of complete stillness today.
ps.p: Lord, I am still, and I know that you are God.

ps.t: "Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy."
ps.a: Worship God joyfully today.
ps.p: God, you are King over all the earth.

ps.t: "Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God."
ps.a: Praise God for His greatness.
ps.p: Lord, you are great and worthy of praise.

ps.t: "Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love... He will be our guide even to the end."
ps.a: Meditate on God's unfailing love today.
ps.p: Father, you will guide me to the end.

ps.t: Wealth cannot buy redemption. Wisdom calls everyone to listen.
ps.a: Do not envy those with more today.
ps.p: Lord, my security is in you, not in money.

ps.t: No one can redeem a life with money. All riches are left behind.
ps.a: Invest in eternal things today.
ps.p: Father, my redemption is precious and only from you.

ps.t: "God will redeem me from the realm of the dead; He will surely take me to Himself."
ps.a: Rest in the hope of eternal life.
ps.p: Lord, you will take me to yourself.

ps.t: "The Mighty One, God, the Lord, speaks and summons the earth."
ps.a: Listen for God's voice today.
ps.p: Father, speak, and I will listen.

ps.t: God does not need our sacrifices; He owns every animal in the forest. He wants thankful hearts.
ps.a: Offer God a sacrifice of thanksgiving.
ps.p: Lord, everything is yours. I give you thanks.

ps.t: "Call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me."
ps.a: Call on God in your trouble today.
ps.p: Father, I call on you in trouble.
