ps.t: "Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; blot out my transgressions."
ps.a: Pray Psalm 51 slowly as your own prayer.
ps.p: Lord, have mercy on me and wash me clean.

ps.t: "Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me."
ps.a: Ask God for a pure heart today.
ps.p: Create in me a pure heart, O God.

ps.t: "Restore to me the joy of your salvation." "A broken and contrite heart you will not despise."
ps.a: Ask God to restore your joy.
ps.p: Father, restore to me the joy of your salvation.

ps.t: Pride and deceit destroy, but God's love endures.
ps.a: Choose honesty in every word today.
ps.p: Lord, guard me from deceitful words.

ps.t: "I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God's unfailing love."
ps.a: Trust God's love forever.
ps.p: Father, I flourish in your house.

ps.t: "God looks down to see if there are any who seek Him." "Surely God is my help."
ps.a: Seek God today; He is your help.
ps.p: Lord, you are my help.

ps.t: "Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me." Then: "Listen to my prayer, O God."
ps.a: Thank God for sustaining you.
ps.p: Father, you sustain me.

ps.t: "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest."
ps.a: When you want to escape, run to God instead.
ps.p: Lord, you are my place of rest.

ps.t: "Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice."
ps.a: Pray morning, noon and evening today.
ps.p: Father, you hear me morning, noon and night.

ps.t: "Cast your cares on the Lord and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken."
ps.a: Cast one care on God today.
ps.p: Lord, I cast my cares on you.

ps.t: "When I am afraid, I put my trust in you. In God, whose word I praise."
ps.a: When fear comes, say: "I will trust you."
ps.p: Father, when I am afraid, I trust in you.

ps.t: "You keep track of my sorrows; you have collected all my tears in your bottle." "God is for me."
ps.a: Remember that God keeps every tear.
ps.p: Lord, you know every tear I have cried.

ps.t: "Have mercy on me, my God, for in you I take refuge." "My heart is steadfast."
ps.a: Take refuge under God's wings today.
ps.p: Father, I take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

ps.t: "I will awaken the dawn... your love is great, reaching to the heavens."
ps.a: Start your day with praise.
ps.p: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens.

ps.t: God is the righteous judge who sees all injustice.
ps.a: Trust God's justice today.
ps.p: Lord, surely there is a God who judges the earth.

ps.t: "Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress."
ps.a: Ask God to be your fortress today.
ps.p: Father, be my fortress.

ps.t: "You, my strength, I watch for you; you, God, are my fortress."
ps.a: Watch for God's help today.
ps.p: Lord, I watch for you, my strength.

ps.t: "I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love."
ps.a: Sing of God's love this morning.
ps.p: Father, you are my fortress and my refuge.

ps.t: God's people felt rejected but turned to Him for help.
ps.a: Turn to God when you feel let down.
ps.p: Lord, restore us.

ps.t: "With God we will gain the victory." "Lead me to the rock that is higher than I."
ps.a: Ask God to lead you to higher ground.
ps.p: Father, lead me to the rock higher than I.

ps.t: "I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings."
ps.a: Spend unhurried time with God today.
ps.p: Lord, I long to dwell with you forever.

ps.t: "Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from Him. Trust in Him at all times."
ps.a: Pour out your heart to God today.
ps.p: Father, my soul finds rest in you alone.

ps.t: "Power belongs to you, God, and with you, Lord, is unfailing love." "Your love is better than life."
ps.a: Tell God His love is better than anything.
ps.p: Lord, your love is better than life.

ps.t: "My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me." "I remember you on my bed."
ps.a: Think of God as you fall asleep tonight.
ps.p: Father, my soul clings to you.

ps.t: "Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life."
ps.a: Bring your honest complaint to God.
ps.p: Lord, protect me from hidden attacks.

ps.t: God turns schemes back on the wicked. "Praise awaits you, our God."
ps.a: Praise God for His justice and mercy.
ps.p: Father, praise awaits you.

ps.t: "Blessed are those you choose and bring near." God crowns the year with His bounty.
ps.a: Thank God for bringing you near.
ps.p: Lord, you crown my year with goodness.

ps.t: "Shout for joy to God, all the earth! Sing the glory of His name."
ps.a: Shout praise to God today.
ps.p: Father, how awesome are your deeds.

ps.t: God tests and refines us like silver.
ps.a: Trust that God is refining you.
ps.p: Lord, refine me like silver.

ps.t: "I will come to your temple... and fulfill my vows to you."
ps.a: Keep a promise you made to God.
ps.p: Father, I will fulfill my vows to you.

ps.t: "God has surely listened and heard my prayer." "May God be gracious to us and bless us."
ps.a: Pray Psalm 67 over your family.
ps.p: Lord, be gracious to us and bless us.

ps.t: "May the nations be glad and sing for joy." "A father to the fatherless... is God in His holy dwelling."
ps.a: Pray for someone who is fatherless or alone.
ps.p: Father, you are a father to the fatherless.

ps.t: "God sets the lonely in families." He provides for the poor.
ps.a: Include someone lonely in your life today.
ps.p: Lord, you set the lonely in families.

ps.t: "The Lord announced the word, and the women who proclaimed it are a mighty throng."
ps.a: Proclaim God's goodness today.
ps.p: Father, your word goes out with power.

ps.t: "Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens."
ps.a: Hand God today's burdens.
ps.p: Lord, thank you for bearing my burdens daily.

ps.t: God's procession in worship brings joy. "Summon your power, God."
ps.a: Ask God to show His strength.
ps.p: Father, summon your power.

ps.t: "Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth... the God of Israel gives power and strength."
ps.a: Praise God for the strength He gives.
ps.p: Lord, you give power and strength to your people.

ps.t: "Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck." Jesus felt this anguish too.
ps.a: Cry out to God when overwhelmed.
ps.p: Father, save me. The waters are deep.

ps.t: "Answer me, Lord, out of the goodness of your love."
ps.a: Ask God to answer you out of His love.
ps.p: Lord, answer me in your great love.

ps.t: "Turn to me in your great mercy." Jesus was given vinegar to drink, as this psalm says.
ps.a: Thank Jesus for what He suffered.
ps.p: Father, turn to me in your great mercy.

ps.t: David felt pain and asked God to protect him.
ps.a: Bring your pain to God honestly.
ps.p: Lord, protect me in my distress.

ps.t: "I will praise God's name in song and glorify Him with thanksgiving." God hears the needy.
ps.a: Praise God in song today.
ps.p: Father, I will praise you with thanksgiving.

ps.t: "Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, Lord, to help me." "Let God be exalted."
ps.a: Pray a short "help" prayer today.
ps.p: Lord, come quickly to help me.

ps.t: "You have been my hope, Sovereign Lord, my confidence since my youth."
ps.a: Thank God for being with you since childhood.
ps.p: Father, you have been my hope since youth.

ps.t: "Do not cast me away when I am old." "My mouth will tell of your righteous deeds."
ps.a: Tell of God's goodness all day long.
ps.p: Lord, I will always have hope.

ps.t: "Since my youth, God, you have taught me... Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me."
ps.a: Pass on God's faithfulness to the next generation.
ps.p: Father, help me declare your power to the next generation.

ps.t: A prayer for a righteous king who defends the afflicted.
ps.a: Pray for leaders to act with justice.
ps.p: Lord, give our leaders your justice.

ps.t: The righteous King will reign forever, and all nations will serve Him.
ps.a: Worship Jesus as the King of all nations.
ps.p: Jesus, all kings will bow before you.

ps.t: "He will deliver the needy who cry out." "Praise be to His glorious name forever."
ps.a: Help someone in need today.
ps.p: Father, may the whole earth be filled with your glory.

ps.t: "Surely God is good to Israel... But as for me, my feet had almost slipped" from envy.
ps.a: Notice envy and give it to God.
ps.p: Lord, guard me from envy.

ps.t: The proud seem to prosper, but they speak against heaven.
ps.a: Do not measure success by the world's standards.
ps.p: Father, keep my eyes on you.

ps.t: Asaph struggled "till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood."
ps.a: Go to God when you are confused.
ps.p: Lord, in your presence I understand.

ps.t: "Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you."
ps.a: Tell God He is your greatest desire.
ps.p: Father, there is nothing on earth I desire besides you.

ps.t: "My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever."
ps.a: Lean on God as your strength today.
ps.p: Lord, you are the strength of my heart.

ps.t: God's people mourned the destruction of His sanctuary.
ps.a: Pray for the restoration of what is broken.
ps.p: Father, remember your people.

ps.t: "God is my King from long ago; He brings salvation on the earth." He made day and night.
ps.a: Remember God's power over creation.
ps.p: Lord, you are my King from long ago.

ps.t: God set the boundaries of the earth. "Rise up, O God, and defend your cause."
ps.a: Ask God to defend His name in the world.
ps.p: Father, rise up and defend your cause.

ps.t: "We praise you, God... it is God who judges: He brings one down, He exalts another."
ps.a: Leave promotion and recognition to God.
ps.p: Lord, promotion comes from you.

ps.t: God holds the cup of judgment. He is resplendent with light.
ps.a: Worship God for His glory today.
ps.p: Father, you are resplendent with light.

ps.t: God breaks the pride of rulers. "Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them."
ps.a: Bring an offering to God today.
ps.p: Lord, you are to be feared.

ps.t: "I cried out to God for help... When I was in distress, I sought the Lord."
ps.a: Seek God in your distress today.
ps.p: Father, I seek you in my trouble.

ps.t: "Has God forgotten to be merciful?" Then: "I will remember the deeds of the Lord."
ps.a: Remember God's past faithfulness when you doubt.
ps.p: Lord, I will remember your wonders.

ps.t: "Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?" He led His people like a flock.
ps.a: Trust that God is leading you.
ps.p: Father, lead me like a shepherd.

ps.t: "We will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord."
ps.a: Tell a younger person something God has done.
ps.p: Lord, let the next generation know you.

ps.t: Teach children to put their trust in God and not forget His works.
ps.a: Remember one of God's works today.
ps.p: Father, help me never forget your deeds.

ps.t: God led Israel by cloud and fire and split rocks for water, yet they tested Him.
ps.a: Thank God instead of testing Him.
ps.p: Lord, forgive my doubting.

ps.t: "Can God spread a table in the wilderness?" He sent manna from heaven.
ps.a: Trust God to provide in your wilderness.
ps.p: Father, you spread a table for me.

ps.t: Despite God's provision, Israel kept sinning.
ps.a: Respond to God's blessings with faithfulness.
ps.p: Lord, keep me faithful when blessed.

ps.t: "They remembered that God was their Rock," yet their hearts were not loyal. He was merciful.
ps.a: Make your loyalty to God real, not just words.
ps.p: Father, thank you for your mercy.

ps.t: Israel forgot God's power and His wonders in Egypt.
ps.a: Remember God's power in your life today.
ps.p: Lord, I will not forget your power.

ps.t: God guided His people safely, like a shepherd.
ps.a: Trust God's guidance today.
ps.p: Father, guide me safely.

ps.t: God brought His people to His holy land, yet they rebelled.
ps.a: Honor God in the place He has brought you.
ps.p: Lord, help me honor you where you have placed me.

ps.t: God allowed discipline, then woke as from sleep to act.
ps.a: Trust that God's discipline is for your good.
ps.p: Father, your discipline is love.

ps.t: "He chose David... and shepherded them with integrity of heart and skillful hands."
ps.a: Lead with integrity and skill today.
ps.p: Lord, give me integrity and skill.

ps.t: Jerusalem lay in ruins. "How long, Lord?"
ps.a: Pray for places that are suffering.
ps.p: Father, have mercy on the hurting.

ps.t: "Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name." "We your people will praise you forever."
ps.a: Ask God for help for His name's sake.
ps.p: Lord, help us for the glory of your name.

ps.t: "Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved." He planted Israel like a vine.
ps.a: Pray "Restore us" over your family or church.
ps.p: Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us.

ps.t: The vine was broken down. "Return to us, God Almighty."
ps.a: Ask God to return and restore.
ps.p: Father, watch over this vine.

ps.t: "Then we will not turn away from you; revive us." "Sing for joy to God our strength."
ps.a: Ask God for revival in your heart.
ps.p: Lord, revive us, and we will call on your name.

ps.t: "I removed the burden from their shoulders." "Open wide your mouth and I will fill it."
ps.a: Ask God to fill your need today.
ps.p: Father, I open my mouth wide; fill it.

ps.t: "If my people would only listen to me... I would feed you with the finest of wheat."
ps.a: Listen to God today and receive His best.
ps.p: Lord, help me listen to you.

ps.t: God judges unjust rulers and calls for defending the weak and fatherless.
ps.a: Defend someone weak today.
ps.p: Father, rise up and judge the earth with justice.

ps.t: Enemies plotted against God's people.
ps.a: Pray for protection for God's people worldwide.
ps.p: Lord, protect your people.

ps.t: God has defeated enemies before.
ps.a: Remember past victories God has given.
ps.p: Father, you have saved before; save again.

ps.t: "Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord, alone are the Most High over all the earth."
ps.a: Pray that people would know God's name.
ps.p: Lord, you alone are the Most High.

ps.t: "How lovely is your dwelling place... Blessed are those whose strength is in you." They go from strength to strength.
ps.a: Find your strength in God today.
ps.p: Father, my heart longs for your presence.

ps.t: "Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere." God forgave His people.
ps.a: Value time with God above all else.
ps.p: Lord, better is one day with you.

ps.t: "Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?" Love and faithfulness meet.
ps.a: Ask God to revive you today.
ps.p: Father, revive us again.

ps.t: "Faithfulness springs from the earth." "Hear me, Lord, and answer me."
ps.a: Pray with confidence today.
ps.p: Lord, answer me, for I am poor and needy.

ps.t: "You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you."
ps.a: Call on God's abundant love today.
ps.p: Father, you are forgiving and good.

ps.t: "Teach me your way, Lord... give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name."
ps.a: Ask God for an undivided heart.
ps.p: Lord, give me an undivided heart.

ps.t: Zion is loved by God, and people from all nations will be counted as born there.
ps.a: Thank God for welcoming people from every nation.
ps.p: Father, all my springs are in you.

ps.t: "I cry out day and night before you." Heman felt overwhelmed by darkness.
ps.a: If you feel overwhelmed, keep crying out to God.
ps.p: Lord, hear my cry day and night.

ps.t: "I call to you, Lord, every day; I spread out my hands to you."
ps.a: Keep praying even when it feels dark.
ps.p: Father, I spread out my hands to you.

ps.t: "Darkness is my closest friend." Even a psalm without resolution is still a prayer.
ps.a: Know that honest lament is still faith.
ps.p: Lord, even in darkness I talk to you.

ps.t: "I will sing of the Lord's great love forever." "Who is like you, Lord God Almighty?"
ps.a: Sing of God's love today.
ps.p: Father, I will sing of your love forever.

ps.t: "Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you."
ps.a: Walk in the light of God's presence today.
ps.p: Lord, blessed are those who walk in your light.

ps.t: God chose David and anointed him. "My hand will sustain him."
ps.a: Know that God sustains those He calls.
ps.p: Father, sustain me in my calling.

ps.t: "My faithful love will be with him." "You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior."
ps.a: Call God your Father today.
ps.p: You are my Father, my God, my Rock.

ps.t: God disciplines but never removes His love or breaks His covenant.
ps.a: Trust that God's love remains even in discipline.
ps.p: Lord, you will not break your covenant.

ps.t: The psalmist struggled when God's promises seemed delayed.
ps.a: Bring your confusion about God's promises to Him.
ps.p: Father, I trust you even when I do not understand.

ps.t: "How long, Lord? Will you hide yourself forever?" "Remember how fleeting is my life."
ps.a: Remember that life is short; turn to God now.
ps.p: Lord, remember me.

ps.t: "Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations." A thousand years are like a day to Him.
ps.a: Rest in God's eternal nature today.
ps.p: Father, you are my dwelling place.

ps.t: Life is short like grass. "Who knows the power of your anger?"
ps.a: Use your short life wisely.
ps.p: Lord, my days are in your hands.

ps.t: "Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom." "Establish the work of our hands."
ps.a: Ask God to establish your work.
ps.p: Father, teach me to number my days.

ps.t: "Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty."
ps.a: Rest in God's shelter today.
ps.p: Lord, you are my refuge and my fortress.

ps.t: "He will command His angels concerning you." "I will be with him in trouble."
ps.a: Trust God's protection today.
ps.p: Father, thank you for being with me in trouble.

ps.t: "It is good to praise the Lord... proclaiming your love in the morning and faithfulness at night."
ps.a: Praise God morning and night.
ps.p: Lord, it is good to praise you.

ps.t: "You have exalted my horn... fine oils have been poured on me."
ps.a: Thank God for His anointing.
ps.p: Father, you have anointed me with fresh oil.

ps.t: "The righteous will flourish like a palm tree; they will still bear fruit in old age." "The Lord reigns."
ps.a: Bear fruit in every season of life.
ps.p: Lord, keep me fruitful to the end.

ps.t: "Rise up, Judge of the earth." God sees the arrogant.
ps.a: Trust God's justice today.
ps.p: Father, you are the Judge of the earth.

ps.t: "Does He who formed the eye not see?" "Blessed is the one you discipline."
ps.a: Receive God's correction humbly.
ps.p: Lord, teach me from your law.

ps.t: "When I said, 'My foot is slipping,' your unfailing love, Lord, supported me."
ps.a: Lean on God's love when you slip.
ps.p: Father, your love holds me up.

ps.t: "When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy."
ps.a: Bring your anxiety to God and receive His comfort.
ps.p: Lord, your comfort brings me joy.

ps.t: "Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord... Come, let us bow down in worship." "Today, if only you would hear His voice."
ps.a: Worship God and listen to Him today.
ps.p: Father, I bow before you, my Maker.

ps.t: "Sing to the Lord a new song... declare His glory among the nations."
ps.a: Share God's glory with someone.
ps.p: Lord, I sing a new song to you.

ps.t: "Splendor and majesty are before Him." "Let the heavens rejoice... He comes to judge the earth."
ps.a: Worship God in the beauty of holiness.
ps.p: Father, splendor and majesty are before you.

ps.t: "The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad." The mountains melt before Him.
ps.a: Rejoice that God reigns.
ps.p: Lord, you reign over all.

ps.t: "Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart."
ps.a: Walk in God's light today.
ps.p: Father, let your light shine on me.

ps.t: "Sing to the Lord a new song, for He has done marvelous things." "Shout for joy."
ps.a: Celebrate God's marvelous works.
ps.p: Lord, you have done marvelous things.

ps.t: "The Lord reigns... Holy is He." "The King is mighty, He loves justice."
ps.a: Worship God as holy today.
ps.p: Holy, holy, holy are you, Lord.

ps.t: "Exalt the Lord our God and worship at His footstool." God answered those who called on Him.
ps.a: Call on God, who answers.
ps.p: Father, you answered them, and you answer me.

ps.t: "Enter His gates with thanksgiving." "I will sing of your love and justice." "I will walk with integrity."
ps.a: Enter your day with thanksgiving.
ps.p: Lord, I enter your gates with thanksgiving.

ps.t: David committed to integrity and to choosing faithful companions.
ps.a: Choose faithful friends.
ps.p: Father, help me walk with the faithful.

ps.t: "Hear my prayer, Lord; let my cry for help come to you." The psalmist felt alone like a sparrow.
ps.a: Bring your loneliness to God.
ps.p: Lord, hear my prayer.

ps.t: "You, Lord, sit enthroned forever... You will arise and have compassion."
ps.a: Trust God's compassion.
ps.p: Father, you will arise and have compassion.

ps.t: God hears the prayer of the destitute and records it for the future.
ps.a: Pray for someone in need.
ps.p: Lord, you hear the prayer of the destitute.

ps.t: "They will perish, but you remain... you remain the same, and your years will never end."
ps.a: Rest in God, who never changes.
ps.p: Father, you remain the same forever.

ps.t: "Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all His benefits... He redeems your life from the pit." He is compassionate and gracious.
ps.a: List God's benefits to you today.
ps.p: Bless the Lord, O my soul.

ps.t: "As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions."
ps.a: Thank God that your sins are removed.
ps.p: Lord, you removed my sin as far as east from west.

ps.t: "The Lord's love is with those who fear Him." "Praise the Lord, all His works."
ps.a: Praise God with all creation.
ps.p: Bless the Lord, O my soul.

ps.t: "Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty."
ps.a: Look at creation and praise God.
ps.p: Father, you are very great.

ps.t: God waters the mountains and makes springs flow.
ps.a: Notice God's care in nature today.
ps.p: Lord, you care for all creation.

ps.t: God provides food and wine to gladden hearts.
ps.a: Thank God for your food today.
ps.p: Father, you provide all I need.

ps.t: "How many are your works, Lord! In wisdom you made them all." All creatures look to Him.
ps.a: Look to God for your needs today.
ps.p: Lord, in wisdom you made all things.

ps.t: "I will sing to the Lord all my life." "May my meditation be pleasing to Him."
ps.a: Make your thoughts pleasing to God.
ps.p: Father, I will sing to you as long as I live.

ps.t: "Give thanks to the Lord... seek His face always. Remember the wonders He has done."
ps.a: Seek God's face today.
ps.p: Lord, I seek your face always.

ps.t: God remembers His covenant forever.
ps.a: Trust God's faithfulness to His promises.
ps.p: Father, you remember your covenant forever.

ps.t: God protected His people. He sent Joseph ahead as a slave to save them.
ps.a: Trust God's plan in hardships.
ps.p: Lord, you send ahead to prepare the way.

ps.t: God raised Joseph to rule and made His people fruitful.
ps.a: Trust that God can raise you up in His timing.
ps.p: Father, raise me up in your time.

ps.t: God sent Moses and Aaron and showed His signs in Egypt.
ps.a: Remember God's power to deliver.
ps.p: Lord, you are mighty to save.

ps.t: God brought His people out with silver and gold, and spread a cloud for covering.
ps.a: Thank God for His covering.
ps.p: Father, thank you for your covering.

ps.t: God gave them bread from heaven and water from the rock, for He remembered His promise.
ps.a: Trust God to provide today.
ps.p: Lord, you remember your promises.

ps.t: "Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good." "Remember me, Lord, when you show favor to your people."
ps.a: Ask God to remember you.
ps.p: Father, remember me with favor.

ps.t: God saved them for His name's sake, yet they soon forgot.
ps.a: Do not forget God's works.
ps.p: Lord, keep me from forgetting.

ps.t: They forgot God their Savior, who had done great things.
ps.a: Remember God as your Savior today.
ps.p: Father, you are my Savior.

ps.t: Moses stood in the breach. Israel worshiped idols.
ps.a: Stand in prayer for someone today.
ps.p: Lord, help me stand in the gap.

ps.t: Phinehas intervened. Moses spoke rashly.
ps.a: Speak carefully today.
ps.p: Father, guard my lips.

ps.t: Israel mingled with the nations and learned their ways.
ps.a: Watch what influences you.
ps.p: Lord, keep me from the world's ways.

ps.t: "Many times He delivered them... He took note of their distress." "Praise the Lord."
ps.a: Thank God for delivering you many times.
ps.p: Father, you have delivered me many times.

ps.t: "Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; His love endures forever." He led them to a city.
ps.a: Give thanks for God's guidance.
ps.p: Lord, your love endures forever.

ps.t: "Let them give thanks to the Lord for His unfailing love." He satisfies the thirsty.
ps.a: Thank God for satisfying your soul.
ps.p: Father, you satisfy my thirst.

ps.t: "He sent out His word and healed them."
ps.a: Ask God to send His word of healing.
ps.p: Lord, send your word and heal.

ps.t: Sailors in the storm were at their wits' end.
ps.a: Cry out to God when you are at your wits' end.
ps.p: Father, I am at the end of myself.

ps.t: "They cried out to the Lord, and He brought them out of their distress. He stilled the storm."
ps.a: Ask God to still your storm.
ps.p: Lord, still the storm in my life.

ps.t: God turns deserts into pools and blesses the needy.
ps.a: Trust God to turn your desert into a spring.
ps.p: Father, turn my desert into pools of water.

ps.t: "Let the one who is wise heed these things." "My heart, O God, is steadfast."
ps.a: Make your heart steadfast in praise.
ps.p: Lord, my heart is steadfast.

ps.t: "Be exalted, O God, above the heavens." "With God we will gain the victory."
ps.a: Trust God for victory.
ps.p: Father, with you I will win.

ps.t: David was attacked with lies. "In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer."
ps.a: Respond to accusation with prayer.
ps.p: Lord, I give myself to prayer.

ps.t: David poured out his pain about those who hurt him.
ps.a: Bring your anger to God instead of acting on it.
ps.p: Father, I give you my anger.

ps.t: David asked God to deal with the wicked. Justice belongs to God.
ps.a: Leave justice to God.
ps.p: Lord, vengeance is yours.

ps.t: "Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your unfailing love."
ps.a: Ask God to help you because of His love.
ps.p: Father, save me by your love.

ps.t: "Let them know that it is your hand." "He stands at the right hand of the needy."
ps.a: Know that God stands with you.
ps.p: Lord, you stand at my right hand.

ps.t: "The Lord says to my Lord: sit at my right hand." Jesus is King and Priest forever.
ps.a: Worship Jesus as King and Priest.
ps.p: Jesus, you are seated at God's right hand.

ps.t: "Great are the works of the Lord." "He provides food for those who fear Him."
ps.a: Ponder God's works today.
ps.p: Father, your works are great.

ps.t: "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom." "Blessed are those who fear the Lord."
ps.a: Grow in reverence for God today.
ps.p: Lord, teach me to fear you.

ps.t: "They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord."
ps.a: Face bad news with a steady, trusting heart.
ps.p: Father, my heart is steadfast in you.

ps.t: "Who is like the Lord our God, who stoops down to look?" He lifts the poor from the dust.
ps.a: Lift up someone who is down today.
ps.p: Lord, you lift the needy from the ash heap.

ps.t: When Israel left Egypt, the sea fled.
ps.a: Remember that creation obeys God.
ps.p: Father, the sea flees at your presence.

ps.t: "Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord." "Not to us, Lord, but to your name be the glory."
ps.a: Give God the glory today.
ps.p: Not to us, Lord, but to your name be the glory.

ps.t: Idols cannot see or hear. "Trust in the Lord; He is their help and shield."
ps.a: Trust God, not lifeless things.
ps.p: Lord, you are my help and shield.

ps.t: "The Lord remembers us and will bless us." "It is we who extol the Lord."
ps.a: Praise God now and forever.
ps.p: Father, you remember and bless us.

ps.t: "I love the Lord, for He heard my voice." "When I was brought low, He saved me."
ps.a: Tell God you love Him because He hears you.
ps.p: Lord, I love you because you heard me.

ps.t: "Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you." "I will lift up the cup of salvation."
ps.a: Rest in God's goodness today.
ps.p: Father, my soul returns to rest.

ps.t: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His faithful servants." "I will offer a thank offering."
ps.a: Offer God thanks today.
ps.p: Lord, I will fulfill my vows to you.

ps.t: "Praise the Lord, all you nations." "His love endures forever." "In my anguish I cried to the Lord."
ps.a: Praise God for His enduring love.
ps.p: Father, your love endures forever.

ps.t: "The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?" "It is better to take refuge in the Lord."
ps.a: Take refuge in God instead of people.
ps.p: Lord, you are with me. I will not fear.

ps.t: "The Lord is my strength and my defense; He has become my salvation."
ps.a: Thank God for being your strength.
ps.p: Father, you are my strength and song.

ps.t: "The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone." "This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice."
ps.a: Rejoice in today as God's gift.
ps.p: Lord, this is the day you have made.

ps.t: "Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord." "Blessed are those who walk according to the law of the Lord."
ps.a: Walk in God's ways today.
ps.p: Father, bless me as I walk in your ways.

ps.t: "How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word."
ps.a: Seek God with all your heart today.
ps.p: Lord, I seek you with all my heart.

ps.t: "I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you."
ps.a: Memorize one verse today.
ps.p: Father, hide your word in my heart.

ps.t: "Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law."
ps.a: Read Scripture asking God to open your eyes.
ps.p: Lord, open my eyes to see wonderful things.

ps.t: "Your statutes are my delight and my counselors." "I run in the path of your commands."
ps.a: Let God's Word counsel you today.
ps.p: Father, your Word is my counselor.

ps.t: "Teach me, Lord, the way of your decrees." "Turn my eyes away from worthless things."
ps.a: Turn your eyes from one worthless thing today.
ps.p: Lord, turn my eyes from worthless things.

ps.t: "May your unfailing love come to me, Lord, your salvation according to your promise."
ps.a: Rest in God's promises today.
ps.p: Father, let your love come to me.

ps.t: "I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts." "Your promise preserves my life."
ps.a: Find freedom in obeying God.
ps.p: Lord, your promise gives me life.

ps.t: "I remember, Lord, your ancient laws, and I find comfort in them." "In the night I remember your name."
ps.a: Find comfort in God's Word tonight.
ps.p: Father, I remember your name in the night.

ps.t: "You are my portion, Lord." "I have considered my ways and turned my steps to your statutes."
ps.a: Consider your ways and turn toward God.
ps.p: Lord, you are my portion.

ps.t: "It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees."
ps.a: Ask what God might be teaching you in hardship.
ps.p: Father, teach me through affliction.

ps.t: "The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver." "Your hands made me."
ps.a: Value God's Word more than wealth today.
ps.p: Lord, your Word is more precious than gold.

ps.t: "My soul faints with longing for your salvation." "I have put my hope in your word."
ps.a: Put your hope in God's Word.
ps.p: Father, I hope in your word.

ps.t: "Your word, Lord, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens." "Your faithfulness continues through all generations."
ps.a: Stand on God's eternal Word.
ps.p: Lord, your Word stands forever.

ps.t: "If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction."
ps.a: Let God's Word carry you through trouble.
ps.p: Father, your Word keeps me alive.

ps.t: "Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long." "How sweet are your words to my taste."
ps.a: Savor one verse throughout the day.
ps.p: Lord, your words are sweet to me.

ps.t: "Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path."
ps.a: Let God's Word guide one step today.
ps.p: Father, your Word lights my path.

ps.t: "You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word."
ps.a: Hide in God when you feel exposed.
ps.p: Lord, you are my hiding place.

ps.t: "I stand in awe of your laws." "Deal with your servant according to your love."
ps.a: Approach God with awe today.
ps.p: Father, I stand in awe of you.

ps.t: "The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple."
ps.a: Ask God to unfold His Word to you.
ps.p: Lord, your Word gives light.

ps.t: "Turn to me and have mercy on me." "Direct my footsteps according to your word."
ps.a: Ask God to direct your steps today.
ps.p: Father, direct my footsteps.

ps.t: "Your promises have been thoroughly tested." "Trouble and distress have come, but your commands give me delight."
ps.a: Delight in God's Word during trouble.
ps.p: Lord, your promises are tested and true.

ps.t: "I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word." "You are near, Lord."
ps.a: Remember that God is near today.
ps.p: Father, you are near.

ps.t: "Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever."
ps.a: Build your life on what lasts.
ps.p: Lord, your Word lasts forever.

ps.t: "All your words are true." "Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble."
ps.a: Receive God's peace through His Word.
ps.p: Father, give me great peace.

ps.t: "May my lips overflow with praise." "My tongue will sing of your word."
ps.a: Let praise overflow from your lips today.
ps.p: Lord, my lips will praise you.

ps.t: "I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands."
ps.a: Let God find you if you have wandered.
ps.p: Father, seek me when I stray.

ps.t: "I call on the Lord in my distress, and He answers me." The psalmist longed for peace.
ps.a: Be a peacemaker today.
ps.p: Lord, I am for peace.

ps.t: "I lift up my eyes to the mountains—where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord."
ps.a: Look to God for help today.
ps.p: Father, my help comes from you.

ps.t: "I rejoiced with those who said to me, 'Let us go to the house of the Lord.'" "Pray for peace."
ps.a: Pray for the peace of your church and city.
ps.p: Lord, may there be peace within our walls.

ps.t: "I lift up my eyes to you, to you who sit enthroned in heaven." "Have mercy on us."
ps.a: Look to God for mercy today.
ps.p: Father, have mercy on us.

ps.t: "If the Lord had not been on our side..." "Our help is in the name of the Lord."
ps.a: Thank God for being on your side.
ps.p: Lord, you have been on my side.

ps.t: "Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken." He surrounds His people.
ps.a: Stand firm in trust today.
ps.p: Father, you surround me like mountains.

ps.t: "Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy." "Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain."
ps.a: Invite God into your work and home.
ps.p: Lord, build my house.

ps.t: "Blessed are all who fear the Lord, who walk in obedience." God blesses the home.
ps.a: Pray a blessing over your home.
ps.p: Father, bless my home.

ps.t: "They have greatly oppressed me, but they have not gained the victory over me." "The Lord is righteous."
ps.a: Know that oppression does not get the last word.
ps.p: Lord, you have cut me free.

ps.t: "Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord." "With you there is forgiveness."
ps.a: Cry to God from your depths.
ps.p: Father, with you there is forgiveness.

ps.t: "I wait for the Lord... more than watchmen wait for the morning." "I have calmed and quieted myself."
ps.a: Quiet your soul before God today.
ps.p: Lord, I have calmed my soul like a weaned child.

ps.t: David vowed to make a dwelling place for the Lord.
ps.a: Make room for God in your life today.
ps.p: Father, I make room for you.

ps.t: "Let us worship at His footstool." God promised David a lasting throne.
ps.a: Worship God humbly today.
ps.p: Lord, I worship at your footstool.

ps.t: God chose Zion as His dwelling. "How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity!"
ps.a: Do one thing to build unity today.
ps.p: Father, make us one.

ps.t: "Praise the Lord, all you servants of the Lord who minister by night." "May the Lord bless you."
ps.a: Bless someone serving faithfully.
ps.p: Lord, bless your servants.

ps.t: "Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good." "The Lord does whatever pleases Him."
ps.a: Trust God's sovereign goodness.
ps.p: Father, you do whatever pleases you, and you are good.

ps.t: God struck down nations and gave His people their inheritance. Idols cannot speak.
ps.a: Trust the living God, not idols.
ps.p: Lord, your name endures forever.

ps.t: "Those who make idols will be like them." "Praise the Lord."
ps.a: Become like the God you worship.
ps.p: Father, make me like you.

ps.t: "Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good. His love endures forever." He made the heavens.
ps.a: Thank God repeatedly today.
ps.p: Lord, your love endures forever.

ps.t: God brought Israel out with a mighty hand. "His love endures forever."
ps.a: Remember God's deliverance.
ps.p: Father, your love endures forever.

ps.t: God led His people through the wilderness. "His love endures forever."
ps.a: Trust God in your wilderness.
ps.p: Lord, you lead me with love.

ps.t: "He remembered us in our low estate." Then the exiles wept by the rivers of Babylon.
ps.a: Remember that God sees you in your low places.
ps.p: Father, you remember me.

ps.t: "How can we sing the songs of the Lord in a foreign land?" Even grief is honest prayer.
ps.a: Bring your sorrow to God honestly.
ps.p: Lord, let me never forget you.

ps.t: "When I called, you answered me; you greatly emboldened me." "The Lord will fulfill His purpose for me."
ps.a: Trust God to fulfill His purpose for you.
ps.p: Father, fulfill your purpose for me.

ps.t: "You have searched me, Lord, and you know me." God knows every thought.
ps.a: Rest in being fully known and loved.
ps.p: Lord, you know me completely.

ps.t: "Where can I go from your Spirit?" Even darkness is light to God. "You knit me together."
ps.a: Remember that you cannot go anywhere God is not.
ps.p: Father, you are always with me.

ps.t: "I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made." "All my days were written in your book."
ps.a: Thank God for how He made you.
ps.p: Lord, I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

ps.t: "Search me, God, and know my heart... lead me in the way everlasting."
ps.a: Ask God to search your heart today.
ps.p: Father, search me and lead me.

ps.t: "Rescue me, Lord, from evildoers." "Lord, you are my God; hear my cry."
ps.a: Ask God to protect you today.
ps.p: Lord, you shield my head in battle.

ps.t: "Set a guard over my mouth, Lord; keep watch over the door of my lips."
ps.a: Ask God to guard your words today.
ps.p: Father, guard my mouth.

ps.t: "Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil." "My eyes are fixed on you."
ps.a: Fix your eyes on God today.
ps.p: Lord, my eyes are fixed on you.

ps.t: "I cry aloud to the Lord... You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."
ps.a: Cry out to God when you feel alone.
ps.p: Father, you are my refuge.

ps.t: "I spread out my hands to you; I thirst for you like a parched land."
ps.a: Thirst for God today.
ps.p: Lord, I thirst for you.

ps.t: "Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love." "Teach me to do your will."
ps.a: Ask God to teach you His will today.
ps.p: Father, show me the way I should go.

ps.t: "Praise be to the Lord my Rock, who trains my hands for war." "What is man that you care for him?"
ps.a: Thank God for training you through challenges.
ps.p: Lord, you are my loving God and my fortress.

ps.t: "I will sing a new song to you, my God." "Blessed is the people whose God is the Lord."
ps.a: Sing a new song today.
ps.p: Father, blessed are those whose God is the Lord.

ps.t: "I will exalt you, my God the King." "One generation commends your works to another."
ps.a: Tell someone about God's mighty acts.
ps.p: Lord, great are you and worthy of praise.

ps.t: "The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love." "Your kingdom is everlasting."
ps.a: Show God's patience to someone today.
ps.p: Father, you are gracious and compassionate.

ps.t: "The Lord upholds all who fall." "The Lord is near to all who call on Him."
ps.a: Call on God; He is near.
ps.p: Lord, you are near to all who call on you.

ps.t: "I will praise the Lord all my life." "Do not put your trust in princes." "Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob."
ps.a: Trust God over people today.
ps.p: Father, my help is in you.

ps.t: God upholds the oppressed, feeds the hungry, sets prisoners free and opens blind eyes.
ps.a: Do something for someone oppressed today.
ps.p: Lord, you lift up those who are bowed down.

ps.t: "He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds. He determines the number of the stars."
ps.a: Bring your broken heart to God.
ps.p: Father, heal my heart and bind my wounds.

ps.t: "The Lord delights in those who fear Him, who put their hope in His unfailing love."
ps.a: Know that God delights in you.
ps.p: Lord, I hope in your unfailing love.

ps.t: God sends snow and frost and then melts them with His word.
ps.a: Watch God's power in creation.
ps.p: Father, your word runs swiftly.

ps.t: "Praise the Lord from the heavens." Sun, moon, stars and sea creatures praise Him.
ps.a: Join creation in praising God.
ps.p: Let everything praise you, Lord.

ps.t: All people, young and old, praise the Lord, "for His name alone is exalted."
ps.a: Praise God with others today.
ps.p: Lord, your name alone is exalted.

ps.t: "Sing to the Lord a new song." "The Lord takes delight in His people; He crowns the humble with victory."
ps.a: Rejoice that God delights in you.
ps.p: Father, you crown the humble with salvation.

ps.t: "Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord!"
ps.a: Praise God with every breath today.
ps.p: Let everything that has breath praise you, Lord!

pr.t: "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge." Wisdom calls out, but fools despise it.
pr.a: Choose God's wisdom over the crowd's advice today.
pr.p: Lord, teach me to fear you and listen to wisdom.

pr.t: Search for wisdom like hidden treasure, and God will give understanding. Wisdom protects you.
pr.a: Spend time seeking God's wisdom today, not just information.
pr.p: Father, the Lord gives wisdom. Give me understanding.

pr.t: "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight."
pr.a: Acknowledge God in one decision today.
pr.p: Lord, I trust you with all my heart.

pr.t: "Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it."
pr.a: Guard what enters your heart today, through your eyes and ears.
pr.p: Father, help me guard my heart.

pr.t: Faithfulness in relationships protects you. Temptation looks sweet but leads to bitterness.
pr.a: Honor your commitments in thought and action today.
pr.p: Lord, keep me faithful and pure.

pr.t: Learn from the ant: work diligently. God hates pride, lies and division.
pr.a: Work diligently on one task today.
pr.p: Father, make me diligent and humble.

pr.t: Keep God's commands like the apple of your eye. Temptation leads step by step to ruin.
pr.a: Avoid the path that leads toward temptation.
pr.p: Lord, keep me far from temptation.

pr.t: Wisdom was with God at creation. "Those who find me find life and receive favor from the Lord."
pr.a: Seek wisdom as you would seek life itself.
pr.p: Father, wisdom is better than gold.

pr.t: "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom." Wisdom invites you to her feast.
pr.a: Accept God's invitation to grow in wisdom today.
pr.p: Lord, I come to your table of wisdom.

pr.t: "Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers all wrongs." Words of the righteous are a fountain of life.
pr.a: Let your words bring life to someone today.
pr.p: Father, let my words be a fountain of life.

pr.t: "A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed." Pride brings disgrace.
pr.a: Refresh someone today with generosity.
pr.p: Lord, make me generous and humble.

pr.t: "The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice." Kind words lift up an anxious heart.
pr.a: Encourage someone who is anxious today.
pr.p: Father, help me listen to wise counsel.

pr.t: "Walk with the wise and become wise." Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.
pr.a: Spend time with someone wise this week.
pr.p: Lord, lead me to wise friends.

pr.t: "There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death." The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life.
pr.a: Check your plans against God's Word today.
pr.p: Father, guide me on the right way.

pr.t: "A gentle answer turns away wrath." The Lord's eyes are everywhere.
pr.a: Answer someone gently today, especially if they are upset.
pr.p: Lord, give me a gentle tongue.

pr.t: "Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and He will establish your plans." "In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps."
pr.a: Commit today's plans to God.
pr.p: Father, I commit my plans to you.

pr.t: "A friend loves at all times." "A cheerful heart is good medicine."
pr.a: Be a loyal friend to someone today.
pr.p: Lord, make me a friend who loves at all times.

pr.t: "The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe." Words have the power of life and death.
pr.a: Run to God's name when you feel unsafe.
pr.p: Father, your name is my strong tower.

pr.t: "Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails." Kindness to the poor is lending to the Lord.
pr.a: Trust God's purpose over your plans.
pr.p: Lord, let your purpose prevail in my life.

pr.t: "The Lord detests dishonest scales." "A person's steps are directed by the Lord."
pr.a: Be honest in all your dealings today.
pr.p: Father, direct my steps and keep me honest.

pr.t: "To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice." The king's heart is in the Lord's hand.
pr.a: Do what is right even when no one notices.
pr.p: Lord, help me do what is right and just.

pr.t: "A good name is more desirable than great riches." "Start children off on the way they should go."
pr.a: Protect your reputation by doing right today.
pr.p: Father, help me value a good name.

pr.t: "Do not wear yourself out to get rich." "Buy the truth and do not sell it."
pr.a: Do not let money drive you today.
pr.p: Lord, my treasure is not in riches.

pr.t: "Do not envy the wicked." "Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again."
pr.a: If you have fallen, get up again with God.
pr.p: Father, help me rise again.

pr.t: "A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold." "If your enemy is hungry, give him food."
pr.a: Do something kind for someone who opposes you.
pr.p: Lord, help me speak the right word at the right time.

pr.t: Do not answer a fool by his folly. Gossip fuels conflict. Laziness makes excuses.
pr.a: Avoid gossip today.
pr.p: Father, keep my words clean.

pr.t: "Do not boast about tomorrow." "As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another."
pr.a: Let a friend sharpen you this week.
pr.p: Lord, thank you for friends who sharpen me.

pr.t: "Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy."
pr.a: Confess one sin to God today.
pr.p: Father, I confess, and I receive your mercy.

pr.t: "Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe." "Where there is no vision, the people perish."
pr.a: Choose to please God over people today.
pr.p: Lord, free me from the fear of man.

pr.t: "Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him." "Give me neither poverty nor riches."
pr.a: Trust God's Word as your shield.
pr.p: Father, give me what I need and keep me close to you.

pr.t: "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves." The woman of noble character fears the Lord. "Charm is deceptive... but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised."
pr.a: Speak up for someone, and honor a person of godly character.
pr.p: Lord, give me strength and dignity, and a heart that fears you.
